original: 1.4.6 śvetāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ caiva sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet | gavāṃ pittena taccūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ subhāvitam

original: 1.4.10 pralepapariṣekeṣu khadiras tu praśasyate | khadirodakapāyī syāt khadirodakabhojanaḥ

original: 1.4.11 bhūyiṣṭhamudakārthe ca kurvīta khadirodaram | sāravantau mahāvṛkṣau dhavarohitakāvubhau

analyzed: aṣṭa bhāga avaśiṣṭam tat sādhitam su pariṣkṛtam pibet kālyam samutthāya śvitrī śīta udakam pibet

original: 1.4.18sarvataḥ parirakṣet tusthāpayeccainamātape | bhaiṣajyapīḍitā doṣās tv acamasyānusaṃśritāḥ

original: 1.4.20 śītābhir adbhiḥ prakṣālya bhojayed rasabhojanam | saṃkṣubhyante ' tha vai toyaparipūrṇā ivāmbudāḥ

original: 1.4.23 tatas tv ālepayetsphoṭān śītodakapariplutān | kṣīriṇāṃ cāpi vṛkṣāṇāṃtvacassaṃkṣodayed bhiṣak

analyzed: añjanam tagaram patram gairikam nīlam utpalam eṣām sūkṣmeṇa cūrṇena sravantam avacūrṇayet

original: 1.4.26 śakṛddrākṣākṣaudrayukto dātavyaḥ paripoṭane | āhārotsādanābhyaṅgaṃ pūrveṇa vidhinā bhiṣak
analyzed: śakṛt drākṣā kṣaudra yuktaḥ dātavyaḥ paripoṭane āhāra utsādana abhyaṅgam pūrveṇa vidhinā bhiṣaj

original: 1.4.27 kārayetkuṣṭhināmevaṃ tataḥ sampadyate sukhī | na ca vyādhimupekṣeta śarīraṃ patitaṃ budhaḥ | tvareta śamane tasya pradīptasyeva veśmanaḥ
analyzed: kārayet kuṣṭhinām evam tatas sampadyate sukhī na ca vyādhim upekṣeta śarīram patitam budhaḥ tvareta śamane tasya pradīptasya iva veśmanaḥ

original: 1.4.28 yathā hyekāntato vṛkṣo vardhate sukhataśśanaiḥ | tathā śarīramāsādya rogovardhata eva tu
analyzed: yathā hi ekāntataḥ vṛkṣaḥ vardhate sukhatas śanais tathā śarīram āsādya rogaḥ vardhate eva tu

original: 1.4.29tasmād rakṣanmahāvegādakṣīṇasyaiva dehinaḥ | prāgevopacayādrogānhanyādvaidyo vicakṣaṇaḥ
analyzed: tasmāt rakṣan mahā vegāt akṣīṇasya eva dehinaḥ prāk eva upacayāt rogān hanyāt vaidyaḥ vicakṣaṇaḥ

original: 1.4.30 tryahāttryahāccāvapīḍaḥ pakṣānmāsādvamettathā | recayed ayane pūrṇe sirāmokṣo vidhīyate
analyzed: tri ahāt tri ahāt ca avapīḍaḥ pakṣāt māsāt vamet tathā recayet ayane pūrṇe sirāmokṣaḥ vidhīyate

original: 1.4.31śyāmākāś ca makuṣṭhāni caṇakāḥ kuṣṭhināṃ hitāḥ | evaṃ hi vartamānānāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ praśamameti vai || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātyāśitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: śyāmākāḥ ca makuṣṭhāni caṇakāḥ kuṣṭhinām hitāḥ evam hi vartamānānām kuṣṭham praśamam eti vai iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele caturthaḥ dhyāyaḥ pañcamaḥ dhyāyaḥ athātyāśitīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.5.1 athāśitena pītena khāditena ca yuktitaḥ | balamāpyāyate jantoḥ sadyo vahnirivendhanaiḥ

original: 1.5.2 tenaivātyādṛteneha bhojanena śarīrajāḥ | vyādhayassaṃpravardhante kāyāgnāvapi dūṣite
analyzed: tena eva ati ādṛtena iha bhojanena śarīra jāḥ vyādhayaḥ saṃpravardhante kāya agnau api dūṣite

original: 1.5.3 dvividhaṃ tu bhiṣagvidyādāhārasyaiva lāghavam | dvividhaṃ gauravaṃbhukte procyamānaṃ nibodhata

original: 1.5.4 mātrālaghussyādāhāraḥ kaściddravyalaghuḥ smṛtaḥ | mātrāgurus tathaiva syād dravyataś ca tathā guruḥ
analyzed: mātrā laghuḥ syāt āhāraḥ kaścid dravya laghuḥ smṛtaḥ mātrā guruḥ tathā eva syāt dravyataḥ ca tathā guruḥ

original: 1.5.12laghu vāpi samāsādya dravyaṃ yo hy atisevate | tallaghvapyatisaṃyuktaṃ koṣṭhe sampadyateguru

original: 1.5.18 snāto ' nuliptaḥ sragvī syāddhautadantassvalaṃkṛtaḥ | dharmassatyamahiṃsā ca prāyohyannaṃ samāśritam
analyzed: snātaḥ nuliptaḥ sragvī syāt dhauta dantaḥ su alaṃkṛtaḥ dharmaḥ satyam ahiṃsā ca prāyaḥ hi annam samāśritam

original: 1.5.19 vamayecchaleṣmarogāṃś ca paittikāṃś ca virecayet | nirūhayed vātarogān raktajāṃś cāvasecayet

original: 1.5.20raktaśālīn samudgān vā ṣaṣṭikānathavā punaḥ | susvinnānmātrayāśnīyāt ghṛtasaindhavasaṃyutān
analyzed: raktaśālīn samudgān vā ṣaṣṭikān athavā punar susvinnān mātrayā aśnīyāt ghṛta saindhava saṃyutān

original: 1.5.21 īṣatpippalikaṃ yūṣamīṣac ca madhunānvitam | īṣatsalavaṇaṃ cāpi payaś cārdhakṛtaṃ pibet
analyzed: īṣat pippalikam yūṣam īṣat ca madhunā anvitam īṣat sa lavaṇam ca api payaḥ ca ardha kṛtam pibet

original: 1.5.22 viṣkirānpratudāṃś cājānjāṅgalāṃś ca mṛgadvijān | yac cānyatkaṭukaṃ pāke bhojyaṃ tan nityam ācaret
analyzed: viṣkirān pratudān ca ajān jāṅgalān ca mṛga dvijān yat ca anyat kaṭukam pāke bhojyam tat nityam ācaret

original: 1.5.23 pādābhyāṃ na caretkṛṣṭe viṣame kaṇṭakeṣu ca | gahanaṃ paradārāṃś ca nadīḥ pūrṇāś ca na vrajet

original: 1.5.24 kalahaṃcāpi kopaṃ ca rātricaryāṃ vivarjayet | gajasya na syādāsannaḥ toyārdrasya ca vājinaḥ

original: 1.5.25 janavādāṃś ca śauṇḍāṃś ca dviṣataś cāpi mānavān | mlecchānnikṛtibuddhīṃś ca na seveta kadācana

original: 1.6.1 na vegāndhārayed dhīraḥ prāptānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ | na vātasya na pittasya na śuklasya kaphasya ca

analyzed: purīṣam ānāham atīva kuryāt retaḥ kurute tha ṣāṇḍyam tasmāt hi vegam na vidhārayeta naraḥ yaḥ icchet iha dīrgham āyuḥ iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ṣaṣṭhaḥ dhyāyaḥ saptamaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas indriyopakramaṇīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.7.1 indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi parijīryanti jīryataḥ | tasmāt sarvatra vayasi yathākālaṃ striyaṃ vrajet

original: 1.7.2 na tvanāpyāyitabalaḥ samāgacchet tu yoṣitaḥ | nāyoniṣu prayuñjīta tiryagyonīś ca varjayet

original: 1.7.5subahusnigdharetāś ca yathartuśayanāśanaḥ | jīrṇāmāsannasatvāṃ ca vyādhitāṃ malināṃ kṛśām

original: 1.7.9 pakṣādvasante grīṣme tu māsi māsi samācaret | nidāghe paścime māse maithunaṃ caiva varjayet

original: 1.7.10 athavā yauvanotsāhabalasnehasamanvitaḥ | śiśirāmbukṛtasnāno hṛdyasraganulepanaḥ

original: 1.7.12 hṛdyayauvanasaṃpannāḥ priyāḥ priyakathānugāḥ | hṛṣṭāḥ sarvatra kāle a śaktyardhena vrajetstriyaḥ

original: 1.16.12 yonyāṃ retaḥ prasiktaṃ ca vāyunā yujyate guṇaiḥ | eṣa pittaṃ kaphaṃ caiva hanyādanyataraṃ tayoḥ
analyzed: yonyām retaḥ prasiktam ca vāyunā yujyate guṇaiḥ eṣa pittam kapham ca eva hanyāt anyataram tayoḥ

original: 1.16.13 ādāya kupito vāyuḥ dehe vipratipadyate | evaṃ vyānamudānaṃ ca samānaṃ ca pracakṣate
analyzed: ādāya kupitaḥ vāyuḥ dehe vipratipadyate evam vyānam udānam ca samānam ca pracakṣate

original: 1.16.14dehe bahuviśeṣitvād apānaṃ prāṇam eva ca | ūrdhvago ' trāpyudānaḥ syād vyānastiryagvivṛddhikṛt
analyzed: dehe bahu viśeṣi tvāt apānam prāṇam eva ca syāt vyānaḥ tiryañc vivṛddhi kṛt

original: 1.16.15 prāṇo nyasyatyapānaṃ tu pravartayati dehinām | samāno dhāraṇaś caiva saṃgṛhṇāti sa dehinām
analyzed: prāṇaḥ nyasyati apānam tu pravartayati dehinām samānaḥ dhāraṇaḥ ca eva saṃgṛhṇāti sa dehinām

original: 1.16.16 indriyāṇi manaś caiva bhūtātmānaṃ ca sammataḥ | viśeṣas tv aparo vāyurapāna iti saṃjñitaḥ
analyzed: indriyāṇi manaḥ ca eva bhūtātmānam ca sammataḥ viśeṣaḥ tu aparaḥ vāyuḥ apānaḥ iti saṃjñitaḥ

original: 1.16.17 śoṣaṇaś caraṇaś caiva tathā vicaraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | vāyuḥ pañcasubhūteṣu bhūtaṃ paramamucyate
analyzed: śoṣaṇaḥ caraṇaḥ ca eva tathā vicaraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ vāyuḥ pañca subhūteṣu bhūtam paramam ucyate

original: 1.16.18 tāni vāyunibaddhāni vāyussarvatra sarvadā | mūtrendriyapurīṣāṇāṃ vāyor utsarga eva ca
analyzed: tāni vāyu nibaddhāni vāyuḥ sarvatra sarvadā mūtra indriya purīṣāṇām vāyoḥ utsargaḥ eva ca

original: 1.16.19 pācanāccaiva bhuktasya karmāpānasya śiṣyate | prāṇaḥ prīṇāti bhūtāni prāṇo jīva iti smṛtaḥ
analyzed: pācanāt ca eva bhuktasya karma apānasya śiṣyate prāṇaḥ prīṇāti bhūtāni prāṇaḥ jīvaḥ iti smṛtaḥ

original: 1.16.20 vyānāccharīraceṣṭā canimeṣonmeṣaṇāni ca | yaccānyadūrdhvagaṃ jantostadudānasya ceṣṭitam
analyzed: vyānāt śarīra ceṣṭā ca nimeṣa unmeṣaṇāni ca yat ca anyat ūrdhva gam jantoḥ tat udānasya ceṣṭitam

original: 1.16.21kṣavathuṃ hikkitaṃ kāsamucchvāsaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ tathā | gudamādhmāpayatyeṣa dehaṃ yassa ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: kṣavathum hikkitam kāsam ucchvāsam bhāṣaṇam tathā gudam ādhmāpayati eṣa deham yaḥ sa ca sarvaśas

original: 1.16.22 eṣu pratiṣṭhito vāyurapāna iti saṃjñitaḥ | ity ebhir īdṛśaiś cānyairhetubhis tattvadarśibhiḥ | bhūtebhyo ' bhyadhikaṃ vātaṃ lakṣayāma śarīriṇām || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele ṣoḍaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || | |saptadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto daśaprāṇāyatanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: eṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ vāyuḥ apānaḥ iti saṃjñitaḥ iti ebhiḥ īdṛśaiḥ ca anyaiḥ hetubhiḥ tattva darśibhiḥ bhūtebhyaḥ bhyadhikam vātam lakṣayāma śarīriṇām iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ṣoḍaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ saptadaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas daśaprāṇāyatanīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.17.1 caturvidhamatho bhuktaṃ daśadhā prāṇamṛcchati | ūṣmasvedaśakṛnmūtrais tathā vātādibhis tribhiḥ
analyzed: caturvidham atho bhuktam daśadhā prāṇam ṛcchati ūṣma sveda śakṛt mūtraiḥ tathā vāta ādibhiḥ tribhiḥ

original: 1.17.2 striyāḥ stanyena śuklena śoṇitena ca vāpy atha | ity ebhir daśabhiḥ prāṇaḥsthirībhavati dehinām
analyzed: striyāḥ stanyena śuklena śoṇitena ca vā api atha iti ebhiḥ daśabhiḥ prāṇaḥ sthirībhavati dehinām

original: 1.17.3īhate ' mṛtavadvṛttiṃ vātapittakaphaistribhiḥ | āhārasāmyayogād dhi vaiṣamye vyādhayaḥ smṛtāḥ
analyzed: īhate mṛta vat vṛttim vāta pitta kaphaiḥ tribhiḥ āhāra sāmya yogāt hi vaiṣamye vyādhayaḥ smṛtāḥ

original: 1.17.4 iha dvau bhiṣajau vidyāt jñaś caivājñaś ca dehinām | tatra jñaḥ sūtravānyaḥ syāt sūtrārthena vicakṣaṇaḥ
analyzed: iha dvau bhiṣajau vidyāt jñaḥ ca eva ajñaḥ ca dehinām tatra jñaḥ sūtravān yaḥ syāt sūtra arthena vicakṣaṇaḥ

original: 1.17.5 pañcāśrayānkaṣāyāṃś ca bhojanaṃcaturāśrayam | catuḥśreṣṭhāṃs tathā snehānāmayāṃś cāturāśrayān
analyzed: pañca āśrayān kaṣāyān ca bhojanam catur āśrayam catur śreṣṭhān tathā snehān āmayān cātur āśrayān

original: 1.17.6 cūrṇapradehānvividhānyavāgūś cāṣṭadhā smṛtāḥ | dvādaśānnāni pathyāni prāyaścittadvayaṃ tathā
analyzed: cūrṇa pradehān vividhāni avāgūḥ ca aṣṭadhā smṛtāḥ dvādaśa annāni pathyāni prāyaścitta dvayam tathā

original: 1.17.7 triṃśataṃ copanāhānāṃ sthāneṣv aṣṭāsu tattvataḥ | sūtrasthānaṃ cikitsā ca triṃśatriṃśadihocyate
analyzed: triṃśatam ca upanāhānām sthāneṣu aṣṭāsu tattvataḥ sūtrasthānam cikitsā ca triṃśatriṃśat iha ucyate

original: 1.17.8 aṣṭau nidānānyuktāni vimānāni tathaiva ca | śārīrāṇyaṣṭa gātrāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ yatra varṇitam
analyzed: aṣṭau nidānāni uktāni vimānāni tathā eva ca śārīrāṇi aṣṭa gātra aṅga pratyaṅgam yatra varṇitam

original: 1.17.9 siddhayo dvādaśa proktās tathā kalpendriyāṇi ca | etadviṃśaśataṃ proktaṃ mūlinyo yatra ṣoḍaśa
analyzed: siddhayaḥ dvādaśa proktāḥ tathā kalpendriyāṇi ca etat viṃśa śatam proktam mūlinyaḥ yatra ṣoḍaśa

original: 1.17.10 ekonaviṃśatirjñeyāḥ phalinyaḥ kṣīriṇītrayam | āyurjñānamariṣṭibhyaḥ sādhyāsādhyacikitsitāḥ
analyzed: ekonaviṃśatiḥ jñeyāḥ phalinyaḥ kṣīriṇī trayam āyuḥ jñānam ariṣṭibhyaḥ sādhya asādhya cikitsitāḥ

original: 1.17.11rogajñānaṃ nidānebhyo deśakālau vimānataḥ | śārīrāddhātusaṃghātaṃ prakṛtiṃ dhātusātmyatām
analyzed: roga jñānam nidānebhyaḥ deśa kālau vimānataḥ śārīrāt dhātu saṃghātam prakṛtim dhātu sātmya tām

original: 1.17.12 anyadevaṃvidhaṃ yac ca śāstre kiṃcidapi śrutam | bhiṣagyo vai vijānāti sajñaḥ ajñaṃ tu nibodhata
analyzed: anyat evaṃvidham yat ca śāstre kiṃcid api śrutam bhiṣaj yaḥ vai vijānāti sajñaḥ ajñam tu nibodhata

original: 1.17.13 yo ' nnakāle yavāgūṃ tu sūpakāle tathā rasam | yūṣakāle ' tha māṃsaṃ tu śodhyeṣu stambhanāni ca
analyzed: yaḥ anna kāle yavāgūm tu sūpa kāle tathā rasam yūṣa kāle māṃsam tu śodhyeṣu stambhanāni ca

original: 1.17.14 virecanīye vamanaṃnirūhye cānuvāsanam | viparyayeṇayo ' nyadvā kurute so ' jña ucyate
analyzed: virecanīye vamanam nirūhye ca anuvāsanam kurute saḥ jñaḥ ucyate

original: 1.17.15 yogena vidyām ādadyāt tasmāt tattvadidṛkṣayā | yathā tamasi dīpaḥ syāt tatrarahā śāstraṃ prakāśakṛt || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele saptadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || || aṣṭādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' nnarakṣīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: yogena vidyām ādadyāt tasmāt tattva didṛkṣayā yathā tamasi dīpaḥ syāt tatrarahā śāstram prakāśa kṛt iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele saptadaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ aṣṭādaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas nnarakṣīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.18.1 gāndhārabhūmau rājarṣirnagnajitsvargamārgadaḥ | saṃgṛhya pādau papraccha cāndrabhāgaṃ punarvasum
analyzed: gāndhāra bhūmau rājarṣiḥ nagnajit svarga mārga daḥ saṃgṛhya pādau papraccha cāndrabhāgam punarvasum

original: 1.18.2 na ca strībhyo nacāstrebhyo na bhṛtyebhyo ' sti me bhayam | anyatra viṣayogebhyaḥ so ' tra me śaraṇaṃ bhavān
analyzed: na ca strībhyaḥ na ca astrebhyaḥ na bhṛtyebhyaḥ sti me bhayam anyatra viṣa yogebhyaḥ me śaraṇam bhavān

original: 1.18.3 evamuktas tathā tasmai maharṣiḥ pārthivarṣaye | viṣayogeṣu vijñānaṃ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ
analyzed: evam uktaḥ tathā tasmai mahā ṛṣiḥ pārthiva ṛṣaye viṣa yogeṣu vijñānam provāca vadatām varaḥ

original: 1.18.4 viṣeṇa saha saṃsṛṣṭamannapānaṃ caturvidham | yāniduṣṭāni rūpāṇi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu
analyzed: viṣeṇa saha saṃsṛṣṭam anna pānam caturvidham yāni duṣṭāni rūpāṇi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu

original: 1.18.5pratikūlamivābhāti phenilaṃ viplutākṛti | śuklaṃ bhavati yatkṣipraṃ nainaṃ śliṣyanti makṣikāḥ
analyzed: pratikūlam iva ābhāti phenilam vipluta ākṛti śuklam bhavati yat kṣipram na enam śliṣyanti makṣikāḥ

original: 1.18.6 dhūmaś cāsya gataḥśyāmo raktaḥ kṛṣṇo ' tha pītakaḥ | prādur bhavati tadvidyād duṣṭamannaṃ pracakṣaṇaḥ
analyzed: dhūmaḥ ca asya gataḥ śyāmaḥ raktaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pītakaḥ prādur bhavati tat vidyāt duṣṭam annam pracakṣaṇaḥ

original: 1.18.7 nīlapītāsitārājyobhantīndrāyudhopamāḥ | madhyemadyeṣu sarveṣu ye cānye pānasaṃśrayāḥ
analyzed: nīla pīta asita ārājyaḥ ubhanti indrāyudha upamāḥ madhye madyeṣu sarveṣu ye ca anye pāna saṃśrayāḥ

original: 1.18.8 anulepanadoṣe tu tvagasya bahulībhavet | sarvavyāpattimāpnoti klidyatemāṃsam eva ca
analyzed: anulepana doṣe tu tvac asya bahulībhavet sarva vyāpattim āpnoti klidyate māṃsam eva ca

original: 1.18.9 mālyaṃ tu śyāvapuṣpaṃ syānmlānaṃ kālaṃ ca dṛśyate | cūrṇayogāvakīrṇaṃ tureṇunevāvṛtaṃ bhavet
analyzed: mālyam tu śyāva puṣpam syāt mlānam kālam ca dṛśyate cūrṇa yoga avakīrṇam tureṇunā iva āvṛtam bhavet

original: 1.18.10 romāṇi pariśīryante keśabhūmiś ca dhūpyate | kūrcasparśaś ca duḥkhaḥ syājjaṭilācāsya mūrdhajāḥ
analyzed: romāṇi pariśīryante keśabhūmiḥ ca dhūpyate kūrca sparśaḥ ca duḥkhaḥ syāt jaṭilāḥ ca asya mūrdhajāḥ

original: 1.18.11 vedanāṃ caiva kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute duṣṭamañjanam | aśru sravati nātyarthamandhakāraṃ ca paśyati
analyzed: vedanām ca eva kaṇḍūm ca kurute duṣṭam añjanam aśru sravati na atyartham andhakāram ca paśyati

original: 1.18.12 dhūmadoṣe virekaḥ syādatyarthaṃ śirasaś ca ruk | paridāhaś ca bhedaś ca gandhajñānamasādhu ca
analyzed: dhūma doṣe virekaḥ syāt atyartham śirasaḥ ca ruj paridāhaḥ ca bhedaḥ ca gandha jñānam asādhu ca

original: 1.18.13 na samyagvetti ca rasānaraṇīva ca mathyate | iti dhūmasya rūpāṇi sarvāṇy etāni lakṣayet
analyzed: na samyak vetti ca ca mathyate iti dhūmasya rūpāṇi sarvāṇi etāni lakṣayet

original: 1.18.14 duṣṭe vāsasi liṅgāni sūcībhir iva tudyate | dahyate muñcatisvedaṃ mūrchatyapyavalīyate
analyzed: duṣṭe vāsasi liṅgāni sūcībhiḥ iva tudyate dahyate muñcati svedam mūrchati api avalīyate

original: 1.18.15 duṣṭe tvābharaṇe dāhaḥ svedaḥ kaṇḍūś ca jāyate | kurute gātravaivarṇyaṃ svayaṃ cābhāti niṣprabhaḥ
analyzed: duṣṭe tu ābharaṇe dāhaḥ svedaḥ kaṇḍūḥ ca jāyate kurute gātra vaivarṇyam svayam ca ābhāti niṣprabhaḥ

original: 1.18.16 duṣṭamāsanamāsthāyī vimūḍho vipaten naraḥ | sīdatyucchūnavṛṣaṇo na cotthātuṃ sahī bhavet
analyzed: duṣṭam āsanam āsthāyī vimūḍhaḥ vipatet naraḥ sīdati ucchūna vṛṣaṇaḥ na ca utthātum sahī bhavet

original: 1.18.17 ūrū cāsya pravepete sadoṣāsanasevayā | duṣṭe tu śayane rūpaṃsuptiḥ kaṇḍūyate bhṛśam
analyzed: ūrū ca asya pravepete sa doṣa āsana sevayā duṣṭe tu śayane rūpaṃsuptiḥ kaṇḍūyate bhṛśam

original: 1.18.18 svedaś ca viṣamatyeti romakūpaiḥ samantataḥ | tudyamānaḥ punaḥ śayyāṃmanyate jantubhir vṛtām
analyzed: svedaḥ ca viṣam atyeti romakūpaiḥ samantataḥ tudyamānaḥ punar śayyām manyate jantubhiḥ vṛtām

original: 1.18.19 sudine durdine cāpi durdine sudinaṃ tathā | syād bhūś ca duṣṭaparyantā duṣṭacchatraniṣevaṇāt
analyzed: sudine durdine ca api durdine sudinam tathā syāt bhūḥ ca duṣṭa paryantā duṣṭa chatra niṣevaṇāt

original: 1.18.20 kurute rūpavaivarṇyaṃ praduṣṭaśmaśruvardhakaḥ | śiśire muñcati svedaṃ grīṣme śītāturo bhavet
analyzed: kurute rūpa vaivarṇyam praduṣṭa śmaśru vardhakaḥ śiśire muñcati svedam grīṣme śīta āturaḥ bhavet

original: 1.18.21 pravepate pravyathate gadgadā ca sarasvatī | syandanau ca vivarṇau ca paruṣau daśanacchadau
analyzed: pravepate pravyathate gadgadā ca sarasvatī syandanau ca vivarṇau ca paruṣau daśanacchadau

original: 1.18.22 upānahau yadā duṣṭau tadā kaṇḍūḥ prajāyate | prasvidyate pādatalaṃ tathā cimacimāyate
analyzed: upānahau yadā duṣṭau tadā kaṇḍūḥ prajāyate prasvidyate pāda talam tathā cimacimāyate

original: 1.18.23 atheha viṣapītasya viṣadagdhasya vā punaḥ | digdhaviddhasya vā rājan rūpāṇīmāni lakṣayet
analyzed: atha iha viṣa pītasya viṣa dagdhasya vā punar digdha viddhasya vā rājan rūpāṇi imā lakṣayet

original: 1.18.24 gātrodveṣṭanamāpnoti vepate vyathate naraḥ | kampate cāpi kaṇṭho ' sya niḥsvanaṃ ṣṭhīvate muhuḥ
analyzed: gātra udveṣṭanam āpnoti vepate vyathate naraḥ kampate ca api niḥsvanam ṣṭhīvate muhur

original: 1.18.25 jihvā cāsya jaḍībhūtāśūlair iva ca tudyate | vyāhartuṃ ca na śaknotiśarma caiva na vindati
analyzed: jihvā ca asya jaḍībhūtā ā śūlaiḥ iva ca tudyate vyāhartum ca na śaknoti śarma ca eva na vindati

original: 1.18.26 keśāntaṃ śīryate cāsya nakhāḥ śyāmībhavanti ca | aṅguṣṭhāṅgulayaḥ kṛṣṇāḥ hastapādatalaiḥ saha
analyzed: keśāntam śīryate ca asya nakhāḥ śyāmībhavanti ca aṅguṣṭha aṅgulayaḥ kṛṣṇāḥ hasta pāda talaiḥ saha

original: 1.18.27 śarīraṃ pāṇḍutāmeti viṣārtasyaiva dehinaḥ | so ' kṛtyakaratāmeti bhagno ratha ivāhave
analyzed: śarīram pāṇḍu tām eti viṣa ārtasya eva dehinaḥ saḥ u kṛtya kara tām eti bhagnaḥ rathaḥ iva āhave

original: 1.18.28 tasmāt kuryāt kriyāṃ vaidyaḥ ṣoḍaśāgadakovidaḥ | hriyā yuktaḥ kulīnaś ca dharmajño dīrghadarśanaḥ
analyzed: tasmāt kuryāt kriyām vaidyaḥ ṣoḍaśa āgada kovidaḥ hriyā yuktaḥ kulīnaḥ ca dharma jñaḥ dīrgha darśanaḥ

original: 1.18.29 arthāś cāsyapratiṣṭheyā vidhivatsaṃbhṛtā gṛhe | cikitsiteṣu yā proktā viṣapraśamane hitā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele ' ṣṭādaśodhyāyaḥ || || ekonaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto vidhiśoṇitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: arthāḥ ca asya pratiṣṭheyāḥ vidhivat saṃbhṛtāḥ gṛhe cikitsiteṣu yā proktā viṣa praśamane hitā iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ṣṭādaśaḥ udhyāyaḥ ekonaviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas vidhiśoṇitīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.19.1 vidhinā śoṇitaṃ jātaṃsevamānasya vāruṇīm | praduṣyati vidāhena tato rogāya kalpate
analyzed: vidhinā śoṇitam jātam sevamānasya vāruṇīm praduṣyati vidāhena tatas rogāya kalpate

original: 1.19.2 sarvaṃ madyamacakṣuṣyamapauruṣyaṃ tathaiva ca | upahanti balaṃ nẏṇāmanāyuṣyaṃ cakīrtyate
analyzed: sarvam madyam acakṣuṣyam apauruṣyam tathā eva ca upahanti balam anāyuṣyam

original: 1.19.3 yas tu tadbhajate yuktyā na taṃ vyādhiḥprasajjate | atipītaṃ ca tadviddhi tatrāhṛdyaṃ balāyana
analyzed: yaḥ tu tat bhajate yuktyā na tam vyādhiḥ prasajjate ati pītam ca tat viddhi tatra ahṛdyam balāyana

original: 1.19.4 na naktaṃ tu, pibedyuktyā pānaṃ tasmād vicakṣaṇaḥ | balavarṇakaraṃ hyetadārogyakaraṇaṃ param
analyzed: na naktam tu pibet yuktyā pānam tasmāt vicakṣaṇaḥ bala varṇa karam hi etat ārogya karaṇam param

original: 1.19.5 snehapāne tathā mātrāvastikarmaṇi cāpy atha | kṣāre ca lavaṇe caiva na surā prātiṣidhyate
analyzed: sneha pāne tathā mātrā vastikarmaṇi ca api atha kṣāre ca lavaṇe ca eva na surā prātiṣidhyate

original: 1.19.6 bṛṃhaṇaṃ nedṛśaṃ kijcidyathānnasahitā surā | tāṃ tu rūkṣāṃ viśeṣeṇa nātimātraṃ samācaret
analyzed: bṛṃhaṇam na īdṛśam kijcid yathā anna sahitā surā tām tu rūkṣām viśeṣeṇa na atimātram samācaret

original: 1.19.7 vātena śleṣmaṇā caivasampraduṣṭāṃ suśītalā | viśoṣya dīpayatyeṣā grahaṇīṃ vai śarīriṇām
analyzed: vātena śleṣmaṇā ca eva sampraduṣṭām suśītalā viśoṣya dīpayati eṣā grahaṇīm vai śarīriṇām

original: 1.19.8 yasya koṣṭhagato vāyurduḥkhamutpādayed bhṛśam | udāvartaṃ sahṛdrogaṃ vātagulmamathāpi ca
analyzed: yasya koṣṭha gataḥ vāyuḥ duḥkham utpādayet bhṛśam udāvartam sa hṛd rogam vāta gulmam atha api ca

original: 1.19.9 athavā sarvagātreṣumārutaḥ pratyavasthitaḥ | yuktāṃ prasannāṃ pibataḥ sa kṣipram upaśāmyati
analyzed: athavā sarva gātra iṣu mārutaḥ pratyavasthitaḥ yuktām prasannām pibataḥ sa kṣipram upaśāmyati

original: 1.19.10 hantyāsavaḥkaphaṃ pittaṃ purīṣaṃ ca bhinattyatha | madhu pittamariṣṭas tu vātārtiṃ śamayatyatha
analyzed: hanti āsavaḥ kapham pittam purīṣam ca bhinatti atha madhu pittam ariṣṭaḥ tu vāta ārtim śamayati atha

original: 1.19.11 vastiḥ śuddhyati pānena śarkarā cāpi bhidyate | tejo balaṃ ca harṣaś ca yuktyā pānena vardhate
analyzed: vastiḥ śuddhi ati pānena śarkarā ca api bhidyate tejaḥ balam ca harṣaḥ ca yuktyā pānena vardhate

original: 1.19.12kāmaṃ dīpayate svādurbṛṃhaṇo na vipadyate | tasmāt pānaguṇān buddhvā yathāyogaṃ samācaret || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele ekonaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || || viṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' rthedaśamūlīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: tasmāt pāna guṇān buddhvā yathāyogam samācaret iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ekonaviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ viṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas rthedaśamūlīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.20.1 artha ity āha hṛdayaṃ tasmin dhamanayo daśa | ūrdhvaṃ catasro dve tiryak catasraś cāpy adhaḥ kramāt
analyzed: arthaḥ iti āha hṛdayam tasmin dhamanayaḥ daśa ūrdhvam catasraḥ dve tiryak catasraḥ ca api adhas kramāt

original: 1.20.2 tābhyo mūlasirāstiryagbhidyante naikadhā sirāḥ | tasmāt tadarthavijñānaṃ smṛtiyogaṃ ca mānasam
analyzed: tābhyaḥ mūlasirāḥ tiryak bhidyante na ekadhā sirāḥ tasmāt tad artha vijñānam smṛti yogam ca mānasam

original: 1.20.3 hṛdo rasoniḥsarati tasmād eti ca sarvaśaḥ | sirābhir hṛdayaṃvaiti tasmāt tatprabhavāḥ sirāḥ
analyzed: hṛdaḥ rasaḥ niḥsarati tasmāt eti ca sarvaśas sirābhiḥ hṛdayam vā eti tasmāt tad prabhavāḥ sirāḥ

original: 1.20.4 hṛdi prāṇāś ca cakrasthāḥ vimāne karṇikā yathā | marmābhighātaṃ tenātra sahate hṛdaye na tu
analyzed: hṛdi prāṇāḥ ca cakra sthāḥ vimāne karṇikā yathā marma abhighātam tena atra sahate hṛdaye na tu

original: 1.20.5 puṇḍarīkasya saṃsthānaṃ kumbhikāyāḥ phalasya ca | etayor eva varṇaṃ ca vibharti hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām
analyzed: puṇḍarīkasya saṃsthānam kumbhikāyāḥ phalasya ca etayoḥ eva varṇam ca vibharti hṛdayam nṛṇām

original: 1.20.6 yathā hi saṃvṛtaṃ padmaṃ rātrāvahani puṣyati | hṛttathā saṃvṛtaṃ svapne vivṛtaṃ jāgrataḥ smṛtam
analyzed: yathā hi saṃvṛtam padmam rātrau ahani puṣyati hṛd tathā saṃvṛtam svapne vivṛtam jāgrataḥ smṛtam

original: 1.20.7 āpo mahārasā vidyādannaṃ caiva mahauṣadham | mahāpralepanaṃ tatra tejaś caivamahatparam
analyzed: āpaḥ mahārasāḥ vidyāt annam ca eva mahauṣadham mahāpralepanam tatra tejaḥ ca eva mahat param

original: 1.20.8 rasānāmudakaṃ yonirannaṃ vṛttiḥ parā smṛtā | viklinnam upasandhatte punaḥ kāyaṃ śarīriṇām
analyzed: rasānām udakam yoniḥ annam vṛttiḥ parā smṛtā viklinnam upasandhatte punar kāyam śarīriṇām

original: 1.20.9 sūryāṃśaṃ dhūmam ity āhuryato ' bhraprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | abhrādvarṣaṃ tato ' nnāni, tasmāt tejo mahatparam
analyzed: sūrya aṃśam dhūmam iti āhuḥ yatas bhra prabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ abhrāt varṣam tatas nnāni tasmāt tejaḥ mahat param

original: 1.20.10 svedaś cāsraṃ ca mūtraṃ ca phenaṃ cāmyantaraṃ malam | avaśyāyahimāmbūni bāhmāni paricakṣate || hṛdayo |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. | |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. iti bhele viṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || | |ekaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. virecyāṃś caiva mānavān | āsthāpyānanuvāsyāṃś ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: svedaḥ ca asram ca mūtram ca phenam ca āmi antaram malam avaśyāya hima ambūni bāhmāni paricakṣate iti bhele viṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ ekaviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ virecyān ca eva mānavān āsthāpya ananuvāsyān ca vāta vyādhīn ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.1 virūkṣayed atisnigdhaṃ kṛmikoṣṭhinam eva ca | rūkṣastambhyān pramehāṃś ca kapharogāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: virūkṣayet ati snigdham kṛmi koṣṭhinam eva ca rūkṣa stambhyān pramehān ca kapha rogān ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.2 vāmayecchaleṣmakāse capratiśyāye ca mānavān | hṛdroge caiva kuṣṭhe ca sarvaśleṣmāmayeṣu ca
analyzed: vāmayet śaleṣma kāse ca pratiśyāye ca mānavān hṛd roge ca eva kuṣṭhe ca sarva śleṣma āmayeṣu ca

original: 1.21.3 vorecayed dhi kuṣṭhāni jvarānvisphoṭakāni ca | dāhaṃ vicarcikāṃ caiva vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: vorecayet hi kuṣṭhāni jvarān visphoṭakāni ca dāham vicarcikām ca eva vāta vyādhīn ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.4 anvāsayetkaṭīpṛṣṭhapārśvarogān vicakṣaṇaḥ | udveṣṭanaṃ cagulmaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: anvāsayet kaṭi pṛṣṭha pārśva rogān vicakṣaṇaḥ udveṣṭanam ca gulmam ca vāta vyādhīn ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.5 āsthāpayed dhi gulmāṃś ca mūtrāghātodarāṇi ca | apasmārāṃś ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: āsthāpayet dhi gulmān ca mūtrāghāta udarāṇi ca apasmārān ca kuṣṭham ca vāta vyādhīn ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.6 svedayeta hanustambhamāyāmam api cārditam | pārśvarogaṃ cagulmaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: svedayeta hanu stambham āyāmam api ca arditam pārśva rogam ca gulmam ca vāta vyādhīn ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.7 stambhayed raktapittaṃ ca visarpaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ | dāhaṃ visphoṭakāṃś caiva pittavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
analyzed: stambhayet raktapittam ca visarpam ca vicakṣaṇaḥ dāham visphoṭakān ca eva pitta vyādhīn ca sarvaśas

original: 1.21.8 iti pittakaphotthānvai vidyād āmāśayātmakān | pakvāśayasamutthāṃś ca vātarogānvinirdiśet
analyzed: iti pitta kapha utthān vai vidyāt āmāśaya ātmakān pakvāśaya samutthān ca vāta rogān vinirdiśet

original: 1.21.9 vāmayed vamanīyāṃs tu samīkṣyāmāśayānnarān | virecayed virecyāṃs tu tathā pakvāśayāśrayān || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele ekaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || || dvāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ svedādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: vāmayet vamanīyān tu samīkṣya āmāśayān narān virecayet virecyān tu tathā pakvāśaya āśrayān iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ekaviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ dvāviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas svedādhyāyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.22.1 saṃkaraṃ prastaraṃ sekaṃnāḍīṃ droṇiṃ jalāni ca | udakoṣṭhaṃ kuṭiṃ caiva svedamaṣṭavidhaṃ viduḥ
analyzed: saṃkaram prastaram sekaṃnāḍīm droṇim jalāni ca uda koṣṭham kuṭim ca eva svedam aṣṭavidham viduḥ

original: 1.22.2 pāṣāṇabhasmasikatātuṣapāṃsubusāni ca | ajāvigopurīṣāṇiprāvārāṇi pravātikāḥ
analyzed: pāṣāṇa bhasma sikatā tuṣa pāṃsu busāni ca aja avi go purīṣāṇi prāvārāṇi pravātikāḥ

original: 1.22.3 payāṃsyamlānidhānyāni girisādhāraṇānica | sarvāṇi madyamāṃsāni lavaṇāni tathaiva ca
analyzed: payāṃsi amlāni dhānyāni giri sādhāraṇāni ca sarvāṇi madya māṃsāni lavaṇāni tathā eva ca

original: 1.22.4 vidhivadyojayetsvedekāleyāgarurūṣitān | bhiṣag balābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā balinodurbalānapi
analyzed: vidhivat yojayet svede kāleya agaru rūṣitān bhiṣaj bala abalam dṛṣṭvā balinā udurbalān api

original: 1.22.5kuthakambalakauśeyaiḥ praveṇyajinakādibhiḥ | kiṭijairāvijairvastraiḥ pracchādya svedayennarān
analyzed: kutha kambala kauśeyaiḥ praveṇī ajinaka ādibhiḥ kiṭijaiḥ āvijaiḥ vastraiḥ pracchādya svedayet narān

original: 1.22.6 sparśasaukhyamavaivarṇyaṃ svedo ' ṅgeṣu ca mārdavam | śītābhinirgamaś caiva samyak svinnasya lakṣaṇam
analyzed: sparśa saukhyam avaivarṇyam svedaḥ ṅgeṣu ca mārdavam śīta abhinirgamaḥ ca eva samyak svinnasya lakṣaṇam

original: 1.22.7 pittaprakopodāhaś ca tṛṣṇā mūrchā vilāyanam | svedadveṣo ' ṅgarāgaścetyatisvinnasya lakṣaṇam
analyzed: pitta prakopaḥ udāhaḥ ca tṛṣṇā mūrchā vilāyanam sveda dveṣaḥ ṅga rāgaḥ ca iti ati svinnasya lakṣaṇam

original: 1.22.8 udveṣṭanaṃ dāruṇatā gurutvaṃ stabdhagātratā | marutaś cāprasiddhiś ca na tatsvinnasya lakṣaṇam
analyzed: udveṣṭanam dāruṇa tā guru tvam stabdha gātra tā marutaḥ ca aprasiddhiḥ ca na tat svinnasya lakṣaṇam

original: 1.22.9 asvinne snehanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ svedair upācaret | snehapūrvaprayukto hi svedo jayati mārutam
analyzed: asvinne snehanam kṛtvā tatas svedaiḥ upācaret sneha pūrva prayuktaḥ hi svedaḥ jayati mārutam

original: 1.22.10 śuṣkāṇy api hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ | namayanti yathānyāyaṃ kiṃ punarjīvato narān
analyzed: śuṣkāṇi api hi kāṣṭhāni sneha sveda upapādanaiḥ namayanti yathānyāyam kim punar jīvataḥ narān

original: 1.22.11 atisvinne viśeṣeṇa kārayecchītalāṃ kriyām | athavā śītalair vātha kṣīraiḥ siṃced ghṛtena vā
analyzed: ati svinne viśeṣeṇa kārayet śītalām kriyām athavā śītalaiḥ vā atha kṣīraiḥ siṃcet ghṛtena vā

original: 1.22.12 pipāsuṃ vā na śaktaṃ ca garbhiṇīṃ kukṣirogiṇīm | sarvāṃś ca pittajān vyādhīnkaḥ svedaiḥ samupācaret
analyzed: pipāsum vā na śaktam ca garbhiṇīm kukṣi rogiṇīm sarvān ca pitta jān vyādhīn kaḥ svedaiḥ samupācaret

original: 1.22.13 ye svedāḥ pūrvamuddiṣṭāstānapyekaikaśaḥ śṛṇu | bilvāgnimanthaśyonākaṃ kāśmarīṃ pāṭalāṃ tathā
analyzed: ye svedāḥ pūrvam uddiṣṭāḥ tān api ekaikaśas śṛṇu bilva agnimantha śyonākam kāśmarīm pāṭalām tathā

original: 1.22.14 yavān kulutthān kolāni sthālyāmāsicya sādhayet | yavapākāni vijñāya sukhoṣmāṇyavatārayet
analyzed: yavān kulutthān kolāni sthālyām āsicya sādhayet yava pākāni vijñāya sukha ūṣmāṇi avatārayet

original: 1.22.15 tato ' bhyaktasya vidhivatsvedanīyasya dehinaḥ | gātraṃ gātraikadeśaṃ vāsukhoṣṇaiśchādayecchanaiḥ
analyzed: tatas bhyaktasya vidhivat svedanīyasya dehinaḥ gātram gātra eka deśam vā asukha uṣṇaiḥ chādayet śanais

original: 1.22.16 tataḥ pracchādayed bhūyaḥ kauśeyājinakāmbalaiḥ | saṅkaras tv eṣa vijñeyaḥ svedānāmagrya ucyate
analyzed: tatas pracchādayet bhūyas kauśeya ajina kāmbalaiḥ saṅkaraḥ tu eṣa vijñeyaḥ svedānām agryaḥ ucyate

original: 1.22.17 etānyanyāni ca bhiṣak svedadravyāṇi saṃharet
analyzed: etāni anyāni ca bhiṣak sveda dravyāṇi saṃharet

original: 1.22.18 prakīrya tāni śayane kalbalenāvaguṇṭhitam | svabhyaktaṃ śāyayejjantuṃ svedaṃ prastaramādiśet
analyzed: prakīrya tāni śayane kalbalena avaguṇṭhitam su abhyaktam śāyayet jantum svedam prastaram ādiśet

original: 1.22.19 vasātailaghṛtakṣīramūtramastvamlakāñjikaiḥ | sukhauṣṇaiḥsecayetsvedyaṃsekaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ
analyzed: vasā taila ghṛta kṣīra mūtra mastu amla kāñjikaiḥ sukha auṣṇaiḥ secayet svedyam sekaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ

original: 1.22.20 nāḍīṃ gajakarākārāṃ trihastāṃ tādṛśīṃ tathā | dhānyāmladravapūrṇāyāṃ dhānyāṃ sandhāya lepayet
analyzed: nāḍīm gaja kara ākārām tri hastām tādṛśīm tathā dhānyāmla drava pūrṇāyām dhānyām sandhāya lepayet

original: 1.22.21 tāṃ trihastāṃ samāhṛtya svabhyaktāṅgasya dehinaḥ | pracchannagātrasya tu tāṃ nāḍīmudghāṭayed bhiṣak
analyzed: tām tri hastām samāhṛtya su abhyakta aṅgasya dehinaḥ pracchanna gātrasya tu tām nāḍīm udghāṭayet bhiṣak

original: 1.22.22 nāḍīsvedaḥ samākhyātaḥ yāvatprasvedanāditi | kaṇṭhāvagāhāmacchidrāṃ tāvadevāyatāṃ samām
analyzed: nāḍīsvedaḥ samākhyātaḥ yāvat prasvedanāt iti kaṇṭha avagāhām acchidrām tāvat eva āyatām samām

original: 1.22.23 droṇiṃ pāyasaniṣkvāthakṛsarakṣīrapūritām | kṛtvā tasyāṃ sukhoṣṇāyāṃ svabhyaktaṃ vātarogiṇam
analyzed: droṇim pāyasa niṣkvātha kṛsara kṣīra pūritām kṛtvā tasyām sukha uṣṇāyām su abhyaktam vāta rogiṇam

original: 1.22.24 jñātvāvagāhayet tāvad yāvat svedodgamo bhavet | taptaiḥ pātrayutair vāpi śuddhair vā salilairbhiṣak
analyzed: jñātvā avagāhayet tāvat yāvat sveda udgamaḥ bhavet taptaiḥ pātra yutaiḥ vā api śuddhaiḥ vā salilaiḥ bhiṣak

original: 1.22.25 svamyaktagātrasya tataḥsalilasvedamācaret | īdṛśair eva salilaiḥ kaṭāhe cārdhapūrite
analyzed: su amyakta gātrasya tatas salila svedam ācaret īdṛśaiḥ eva salilaiḥ kaṭāhe ca ardha pūrite

original: 1.22.26 praveśya svedayetsvedyamudakoṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | suliptāṃ saṃvṛtadvārāṃyantritāṃ kārayetkuṭim
analyzed: praveśya svedayet svedyam uda koṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ su liptām saṃvṛta dvārām yantritām kārayet kuṭim

original: 1.22.27 hrasvāgāramitāṃ hṛdyāṃ śilāstīrṇatalāṃ dṛḍhām | tāsyāścullyau ca kartavye adhastātpārśvasaṃvṛte
analyzed: hrasva āgāra mitām hṛdyām śilā āstīrṇa talām dṛḍhām tāsyāḥ cullyau ca kartavye adhastāt pārśva saṃvṛte

original: 1.22.28 tatra sthālyau pratiṣṭhāpya sarvataḥ paribṛṃhayet | sthālyau tapte kuṭiś cāpi yadā tenoṣmaṇā tadā
analyzed: tatra sthālyau pratiṣṭhāpya sarvatas paribṛṃhayet sthālyau tapte kuṭiḥ ca api yadā tena ūṣmaṇā tadā

original: 1.22.29 sarvāṅgarogipuruṣaḥ praviśetsa kuṭiṃ tataḥ | svabhyaktagātraḥ susvinnaḥ kṣaumaprāvṛtalocanaḥ
analyzed: sarva aṅga rogi puruṣaḥ praviśet sa kuṭim tatas su abhyakta gātraḥ su svinnaḥ kṣauma prāvṛta locanaḥ

original: 1.22.30 tataḥ praveśayet tatra śītāmbumaṇikāṃ śubhām | klāntaḥ śītāmvunā tatra sparśasaukhyam avāpnuyāt
analyzed: tatas praveśayet tatra śītāmbu maṇikām śubhām klāntaḥ śītāmvunā tatra sparśa saukhyam avāpnuyāt

original: 1.22.31 kuṭisveda iti jñeyaḥ sadyo roganivartakaḥ | svedo ' gnihīnaḥkṣuttṛṣṇābhayaṃ krodhastathāhavaḥ
analyzed: kuṭisvedaḥ iti jñeyaḥ sadyas roga nivartakaḥ svedaḥ gni hīnaḥ kṣudh tṛṣṇā bhayam krodhaḥ tathā āhavaḥ

original: 1.22.32 nivātamadhvasantāpau guruprāvaraṇaṃ tathā | svedyās tu vātakaphajā vātajāḥ kaphajās tathā
analyzed: nivāta madhu asantāpau guru prāvaraṇam tathā svedyāḥ tu vāta kapha jāḥ vāta jāḥ kapha jāḥ tathā

original: 1.22.33rogāstatroṣṇalavaṇasnigdhāmlair eva vātajāḥ | karīṣabusapāṣāṇabāṣpāṅgāraiḥkaphātmakāḥ | svedyās tu snigdharūkṣābhyāṃ jñātvā vyādhibalābalam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele dvāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || || trayoviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto gāḍhapurīṣīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
