original: 1.26.9 aruṇā nīlapītāś ca haritaśvetalohitāḥ | kācaṃ ca liṅganāśaṃ ca timirāṇi ca nirdiśet
analyzed: aruṇāḥ nīla pītāḥ ca harita śveta lohitāḥ kācam ca liṅganāśam ca timirāṇi ca nirdiśet

original: 1.26.10 vātaḥ pittaṃ kapho vāpi yasya śīrṣaṃ vidhāvati | vidahanneṣa mūlāni srotāṃsi samabhidrutaḥ
analyzed: vātaḥ pittam kaphaḥ vā api yasya śīrṣam vidhāvati vidahan eṣa mūlāni srotāṃsi samabhidrutaḥ

original: 1.26.11adhvanā vātibhārādvā dehināṃvārdhakena vā | khālity aṃ palitaṃ vāpi pañcadhaiva bhavatyatha
analyzed: adhvanā vā ati bhārāt vā dehinām vā ardhakena vā palitam vā api pañcadhā eva bhavati atha

original: 1.26.12 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ māṃsajaṃ tathā | arbudaṃ medasā caiva pañcamaṃ nirdiśetpṛthak
analyzed: vāta jam pitta jam ca eva śleṣma jam māṃsa jam tathā arbudam medasā ca eva pañcamam nirdiśet pṛthak

original: 1.26.13 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃsannipātajam | āgantukaṃ pañcamaṃ ca mukharogaṃ pracakṣate
analyzed: vāta jam pitta jam ca eva śleṣma jam sannipāta jam āgantukam pañcamam ca mukha rogam pracakṣate

original: 1.26.14 uṣṭragrīvaṃ parisrāvi śambūkāvartam eva ca | unmārgaṃ śatayoniṃ ca tadvadvidyādbhagandaram
analyzed: uṣṭragrīvam parisrāvi śambūkāvartam eva ca unmārgam śatayonim ca tadvat vidyāt bhagaṃdaram

original: 1.26.15 chardayatyatha vātena pittena ca kaphena ca | āhārādamanojñācca sannipātāc ca pañcamam
analyzed: chardayati atha vātena pittena ca kaphena ca āhārāt amanojñāt ca sannipātāt ca pañcamam

original: 1.26.16praticchanne tu hṛdaye vātapittakaphairnaraḥ | arasādamanojñāc ca bhojyamannaṃna sevate
analyzed: praticchanne tu hṛdaye vāta pitta kaphaiḥ naraḥ arasāt amanojñāt ca bhojyam annam na sevate

original: 1.26.17 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ sannipātajam | sirāgranthiṃ vijānīyāt pañcamaṃ snāyuto bhiṣak
analyzed: vāta jam pitta jam ca eva śleṣma jam sannipāta jam sirāgranthim vijānīyāt pañcamam snāyutaḥ bhiṣak

original: 1.26.18 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiv kaphajaṃ sannipātajam | abhiṣyandaṃ vijānīyādadhimanthaṃ ca buddhimān
analyzed: vāta jam pitta jam ca eva kapha jam sannipāta jam abhiṣyandam vijānīyāt adhimantham ca buddhimān

original: 1.26.19 śukloparodhāddaurbalyād dhvajabhaṅgāttathaiva ca | śukrakṣayāc ca catvāri klaibyasthānāni nirdiśet
analyzed: śukra uparodhāt daurbalyāt dhvajabhaṅgāt tathā eva ca śukra kṣayāt ca catvāri klaibya sthānāni nirdiśet

original: 1.26.20 vātajaṃ pittjaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ sannipātajam | akṣirogaṃ vijānīyānmānavānāṃ caturvidham
analyzed: vāta jam pitta jam ca eva śleṣma jam sannipāta jam akṣi rogam vijānīyāt mānavānām caturvidham

original: 1.26.21 pūyānmūtrāc ca śuklāc ca sandhānāc cāpi dehinām | upadaṃśaṃ vijānīyādbhiṣagevaṃ caturvidham
analyzed: pūyāt mūtrāt ca śuklāt ca sandhānāt ca api dehinām upadaṃśam vijānīyāt bhiṣaj evam caturvidham

original: 1.26.22 raktāsrāvaṃ kaphasrāvaṃ pūyāsrāvaṃ tathaiva ca | toyāsrāvaṃ ca jānīyādbhiṣagevaṃ caturvidham
analyzed: rakta āsrāvam kapha srāvam pūya āsrāvam tathā eva ca toya āsrāvam ca jānīyāt bhiṣaj evam caturvidham

original: 1.26.23 vātajāṃ pittajāṃ caiva śleṣmajāṃ sannipātajām | pipāsām api jānīyādbhiṣagevaṃ caturvidhām
analyzed: vāta jām pitta jām ca eva śleṣma jām sannipāta jām pipāsām api jānīyāt bhiṣaj evam caturvidhām

original: 1.26.24 vātajāṃ pittajāṃ caiva śleṣmajāṃ sannpātajām | vidyādrohiṇikāṃ caiva bhiṣagevaṃ caturvidhām
analyzed: vāta jām pitta jām ca eva śleṣma jām sannpāta jām vidyāt rohiṇikām ca eva bhiṣaj evam caturvidhām

original: 1.26.25 māṃsārma tvatha medo ' rmaprastāryarma tathaiva ca | snāyavarma pravijānīyād bhiṣagevaṃ caturvidham
analyzed: māṃsa arma tu atha medaḥ rma prastāri arma tathā eva ca snāyavarma pravijānīyāt bhiṣaj evam caturvidham

original: 1.26.26 dvau jvarau dāhaśītau tuśārīrāgantujavraṇau | śuṣkārśaḥ śoṇitārśaś ca tathā dvecārśasī viduḥ
analyzed: dvau jvarau dāha śītau tu śārīra āgantu ja vraṇau śuṣkārśaḥ śoṇitārśaḥ ca tathā viduḥ

original: 1.26.27 pṛṣṭharogāvupakṣārikṣāriṇau ca vinirdiśet | bāhyāyāmāntarāyāmau vidyādākṣepakau tathā
analyzed: pṛṣṭha rogau upakṣāri kṣāriṇau ca vinirdiśet bāhyāyāma antarāyāmau vidyāt ākṣepakau tathā

original: 1.26.28 medasaḥ snāyuto māṃsādalajyastisra eva ca | vātātpittātkaphāccaiva tisro vidradhayaḥ smṛtāḥ
analyzed: medasaḥ snāyutaḥ māṃsāt alajyaḥ tisraḥ eva ca vātāt pittāt kaphāt ca eva tisraḥ vidradhayaḥ smṛtāḥ

original: 1.26.29 varāhākāraṇaṃ caiva raktaṃ kāṃsyavakaṃ tathā(?) | vātātpittātkaphānmāṃsānmedasaḥ snāyutoapi ca
analyzed: varāha akāraṇam ca eva raktam kāṃsyavakam tathā vātāt pittāt kaphāt māṃsāt medasaḥ snāyutaḥ api ca

original: 1.26.30 sirājamarma jānīyāt saptamaṃ dehināṃ bhiṣak | sapta sātmyāni jānīyāt tatraṣaṭ syuryathā rasaiḥ
analyzed: sirā jamarma jānīyāt saptamam dehinām bhiṣak sapta sātmyāni jānīyāt tatra ṣaṭ syuḥ yathā rasaiḥ

original: 1.26.31sarvasātmyaṃ yadeva syādvaraṃ sātmyaṃ taducyate | mṛjjā jarāyujā levā rūpakā bahurūpakāḥ
analyzed: sarva sātmyam yat eva syāt varam sātmyam tat ucyate mṛjjāḥ jarāyu jāḥ levāḥ rūpakāḥ bahurūpakāḥ

original: 1.26.32 parisarpā visarpāś ca gātrajā netrajās tathā | romadā rohitāś caiva kaṣṭā dāruṇakās tathā
analyzed: parisarpāḥ visarpāḥ ca gātra jāḥ netra jāḥ tathā romadāḥ rohitāḥ ca eva kaṣṭāḥ dāruṇakāḥ tathā

original: 1.26.33 śirojā dantajāś caiva śleṣmajāḥ śakṛdāśrayāḥ | lohitāḥ kālakāś caiva tathaiva śatamātṛkāḥ
analyzed: śiraḥ jāḥ danta jāḥ ca eva śleṣma jāḥ śakṛt āśrayāḥ lohitāḥ kālakāḥ ca eva tathā eva śatamātṛkāḥ

original: 1.26.34 vidyādviṃśatirity etāḥ kṛmijātīś ca dehinām | yathā patatriḥ śīghro ' pi svāṃ chāyāṃ nātivartate | vātādernātivartante bahavo ' pi tathāāmayāḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele ṣaḍviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || | |saptaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' nnapānavidhīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: vidyāt viṃśatiḥ iti etāḥ kṛmi jātīḥ ca dehinām yathā patatriḥ svām chāyām na ativartate vāta ādeḥ na ativartante bahavaḥ pi tathā āmayāḥ iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ṣaḍviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ saptaviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas nnapānavidhīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.27.1 athodakaṃ kledayati lavaṇaṃ syandayaty api | athapācayati kṣāraḥ kṣīraṃ vai jīvayaty api
analyzed: atha udakam kledayati lavaṇam syandayati api atha pācayati kṣāraḥ kṣīram vai jīvayati api

original: 1.27.2 snehayatyatha sarpiś ca piśitaṃ bṛṃhayaty api | māṣā bahumalāś cāpi ślīpadaṃ janayed dadhi
analyzed: snehayati atha sarpiḥ ca piśitam bṛṃhayati api māṣāḥ bahu malāḥ ca api ślīpadam janayet dadhi

original: 1.27.3 tvacaṃ prasādayet tailaṃ snehanāya ca kalpate | piṇyākaḥ kurute glāniṃ takraṃ ca kṣapayaty api
analyzed: tvacam prasādayet tailam snehanāya ca kalpate piṇyākaḥ kurute glānim takram ca kṣapayati api

original: 1.27.4 madhu cāpy atha sandhatte jarjarīkurute surā | hareṇubhir masūraiś ca bhṛśaṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati
analyzed: madhu ca api atha sandhatte jarjarīkurute surā hareṇubhiḥ masūraiḥ ca bhṛśam vāyuḥ prakupyati

original: 1.27.5 kaphakṛnmūlakaṃ vidyāt sarṣapaṃ vātakopanam | laśunaṃ vātaśamanaṃ pittaśleṣmakaraṃ ca tat
analyzed: kapha kṛt mūlakam vidyāt sarṣapam vāta kopanam laśunam vāta śamanam pitta śleṣma karam ca tat

original: 1.27.6 nātiśleṣmakaraṃ hiṅgu ṣaṇḍyaṃ kṣāraḥ karoti ca | sarvaṃ tiktamavṛṣyaṃtu vidyādanyatra kūlakāt
analyzed: na ati śleṣma karam hiṅgu ṣaṇḍyam kṣāraḥ karoti ca sarvam tiktam avṛṣyam tu vidyāt anyatra kūlakāt

original: 1.27.7 avṛṣyaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ sarvaṃ yavagodhūmavarjitam | dāḍimāmalakādanyatsarvamamlaṃ tu pittalam
analyzed: avṛṣyam paiṣṭikam sarvam yava godhūma varjitam dāḍima āmalakāt anyat sarvam amlam tu pittalam

original: 1.27.8 yavakān dāruṇān vidyāt pṛthukānśāliṣaṣṭikān | nirdiśenmṛgatulyāṃs tu tathānūpānmṛgadvijān
analyzed: yavakān dāruṇān vidyāt pṛthukān śāli ṣaṣṭikān nirdiśet mṛga tulyān tu tathā ānūpān mṛga dvijān

original: 1.27.9tathaikāntahitāṃś cāpi jāṃgalānmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | ity etatsaṃgraheṇoktaṃ bhojyaṃ vistarataḥ śṛṇu
analyzed: tathā ekānta hitān ca api jāṃgalān mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ iti etat saṃgraheṇa uktam bhojyam vistarataḥ śṛṇu

original: 1.27.10 pippalī śṛṅgiberaṃ ca palāṇḍulaśunāni ca | mūlakaṃ kṛśṇagandhā ca parṇāsaṃ kālamānakam
analyzed: pippalī śṛṅgiveram ca palāṇḍu laśunāni ca mūlakam kṛśṇagandhā ca parṇāsim kālamānakam

original: 1.27.11 surasaṃ sumukhaṃ caiva caṭakaṃ ca phaṇijjakam | rasena kaṭukaṃ vidyāt vipāke madhuraṃ tathā
analyzed: surasam sumukham ca eva caṭakam ca phaṇijjakam rasena kaṭukam vidyāt vipāke madhuram tathā

original: 1.27.12 kirātatikto nimbaś ca ketukāśakaṭhillakāḥ | kūlakaṃ ca savetrāgraṃtiktaṃ madhuvipāki ca
analyzed: kirātatiktaḥ nimbaḥ ca ketu kāśa kaṭhillakāḥ kūlakam ca sa vetra agraṃtiktam madhu vipāki ca

original: 1.27.13 plakṣakāśmaryamadhukaṃ svādupāke parūṣakam | kharjūraṃ nālikeraṃ ca priyālaṃtadvidhāni ca
analyzed: plakṣa kāśmarya madhukam svādu pāke parūṣakam kharjūram nālikeram ca priyālam tadvidhāni ca

original: 1.27.14 madhukaṃ cabisaṃ caivajīvanīyāni yāni ca | rase pāke ca madhuraṃ tadvidyād vividhaṃ ca yat
analyzed: madhukam ca bisam ca eva jīvanīyāni yāni ca rase pāke ca madhuram tat vidyāt vividham ca yat

original: 1.27.15 basāni kaṭukā bimbī sarvaṃ caivekṣuvaikṛtam | rase pāke ca madhuraṃ tad vidyāt trividhaṃ ca yat
analyzed: basāni kaṭukā bimbī sarvam ca eva ikṣu vaikṛtam rase pāke ca madhuram tat vidyāt trividham ca yat

original: 1.27.16 nyaṅkuṃ carasamudrāṃś casṛmarānkhaḍgasūkarān | anyāṃś cānūpajān vidyānmadhurān rasapākataḥ
analyzed: nyaṅkum cara samudrān ca sṛmarān khaḍga sūkarān anyān ca anūpa jān vidyāt madhurān rasa pākataḥ

original: 1.27.17 kādambānsaindhavānhaṃsānsārasāñścetavāraṇam | kācākṣānmallikākṣāṃś ca tathā puṣkarasāyakān
analyzed: kādambān saindhavān haṃsān sārasān cetavāraṇam kācākṣān mallikākṣān ca tathā puṣkarasāyakān

original: 1.27.18 dipavepni(?)śarārīṃś ca vikramān sumanāmukhān | nandimaudgalyakāṃś cāpi kālakān kṛṣṇapucchakān
analyzed: ca vikramān sumanāmukhān nandi maudgalyakān ca api kālakān kṛṣṇapucchakān

original: 1.27.19 ājñātān ḍuṇḍubhāṃś caiva maṇḍūkān chuṭumallikān | harṣyāt tu saptavārādi tathā garbhabhatāsakān(?)
analyzed: ājñātān ḍuṇḍubhān ca eva maṇḍūkān chuṭumallikān harṣyāt tu sapta vāra ādi tathā garbha bha tāsakān

original: 1.27.20 sarvāṃś ca vārijānvidyānmadhurān rasapākataḥ | priyaṅguś ca plāṅgaś ca balākāś ca khagās tathā
analyzed: sarvān ca vāri jān vidyāt madhurān rasa pākataḥ priyaṅguḥ ca plāṅgaḥ ca balākāḥ ca khagāḥ tathā

original: 1.27.21 ye cānye ' pyaudakā bhaumyāḥ khecarāś ca khagāḥ smṛtāḥ | nakrāṃś ca śiśumārāṃś ca vallakīmatsyakacchapān
analyzed: ye ca anye bhaumyāḥ khecarāḥ ca khagāḥ smṛtāḥ nakrān ca śiśumārān ca vallakī matsya kacchapān

original: 1.27.22 anyāṃś ca vārijānvidyānmadhurānrasapākataḥ | priyaṅguś ca vinaktāś ca nīlikāśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ
analyzed: anyān ca vāri jān vidyāt madhurān rasa pākataḥ priyaṅguḥ ca vinaktāḥ ca nīlikā śāli ṣaṣṭikāḥ

original: 1.27.23 parūṣakāś ca nīvārāḥ kodravā brahmabhūtikāḥ | ity etaddhānyajātaṃ vai yaccānyadapi tadvidham
analyzed: parūṣakāḥ ca nīvārāḥ kodravāḥ brahmabhūtikāḥ iti etat dhānya jātam vai yat ca anyat api tadvidham

original: 1.27.24 rasena madhuraṃ tadvai vipāke kaṭukaṃ viduḥ | mudgān masūrāṃś caṇakān kulutthāṃś ca kalāyakān
analyzed: rasena madhuram tat vai vipāke kaṭukam viduḥ mudgān masūrān caṇakān kulutthān ca kalāyakān

original: 1.27.25 rasena madhurāṃstānvai vipāke kaṭukānviduḥ | rohīṃ śvadaṃṣṭrānuṣṭrāṃś ca śarabhānmṛgamātṛkān
analyzed: rasena madhurān tān vai vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ rohīm śvadaṃṣṭrān uṣṭrān ca śarabhān mṛgamātṛkān

original: 1.27.26 athānyānmadhurāsvādānvipāke kaṭukānviduḥ | kharāś cāścatarāmeṣā ye cānye tādṛśā mṛgāḥ
analyzed: atha anyān madhura āsvādān vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ kharāḥ ye ca anye tādṛśāḥ mṛgāḥ

original: 1.27.27 rasena madhurāṃstānvai vipāke kaṭukānviduḥ | harītān stokakāṃś caiva kapotān śukaśārikāḥ
analyzed: rasena madhurān tān vai vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ harītān stokakān ca eva kapotān śuka śārikāḥ

original: 1.27.28 caṭakān bhṛṅgarājāṃś ca tathā pippalakānapi | godhāputrāṃstailapākānye cānye pratudāḥ khagāḥ
analyzed: caṭakān bhṛṅgarājān ca tathā pippalakān api godhāputrān tailapākān ye ca anye pratudāḥ khagāḥ

original: 1.27.29 ye cānye madhurāstānvai vipāke kaṭukānviduḥ | anupānāni vakṣyāmiyeṣu yāni hitāni vai
analyzed: ye ca anye madhurāḥ tān vai vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ anupānāni vakṣyāmi iyeṣu yāni hitāni vai

original: 1.27.30 āje kaṣāyaśītas tu hāyanecodakaṃ tathā | anupānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ vārāhe khadirodaram
analyzed: āje kaṣāya śītaḥ tu tathā anupānam vidhātavyam vārāhe khadira udaram

original: 1.27.31 dadhi cukraṃ ca dhānyānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet | śīrodakaṃbisagranthisevanānāṃ tathāsavān
analyzed: dadhi cukram ca dhānyānām anupānam pradāpayet śīra udakam bisa granthi sevanānām tathā āsavān

original: 1.27.32 tadvārijānāṃ satvānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet | triphalāṃ śīdhumārdvīkaṃ kadambapanasodakam
analyzed: tad vāri jānām sattvānām anupānam pradāpayet triphalām śīdhu mārdvīkam kadamba panasa udakam

original: 1.27.33 suradrujambūplakṣāṇāṃ phalaskandhāsavānpṛthak | mudgādisūpadhānyānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet
analyzed: suradru jambu plakṣāṇām phala skandha āsavān pṛthak mudga ādi sūpa dhānyānām anupānam pradāpayet

original: 1.27.34 bilvapiṇḍakakalkānāṃ kapitthasyāthavāsavān | guhāśayānāṃ satvānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet
analyzed: bilva piṇḍaka kalkānām kapitthasya athavā asavān guhā āśayānām sattvānām anupānam pradāpayet

original: 1.27.35 nyagrodhādigaṇasyātha skandhaśākhāphalāsavān | viṣkirāṇāṃ vihaṅgānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet
analyzed: nyagrodhādi gaṇasya atha skandha śākhā phala āsavān viṣkirāṇām vihaṅgānām anupānam pradāpayet

original: 1.27.36 kakubhasyānupānaṃ tu snigdhānāṃ cāpi vāruṇīm | caturvidhasya snehasya toyamuṣṇaṃ pradāpayet
analyzed: kakubhasya anupānam tu snigdhānām ca api vāruṇīm caturvidhasya snehasya toyam uṣṇam pradāpayet

original: 1.27.37 drākṣākāśmaryakharjūrayavavāṭyāṃstathāsavān | aśvagandhakaṣāyaṃ tu vāruṇīmaṇḍam eva ca
analyzed: drākṣā kāśmarya kharjūra yava vāṭyān tathā āsavān aśvagandha kaṣāyam tu vāruṇī maṇḍam eva ca

original: 1.27.38 sukhena pācayaty annaṃ rocayaty apakarṣati | anupānaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃsātmyatāṃ ca prayacchati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele saptaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || || aṣṭāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto bhojanavidhīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: sukhena pācayati annam rocayati apakarṣati anupānam manuṣyāṇām sātmya tām ca prayacchati iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele saptaviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ aṣṭāviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas bhojanavidhīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 1.28.1 yad bhakṣayati bhuṅkte vā vidhivac cāpi mānavaḥ | anyac ca kiñcit pibati tat sarvaṃ ṣaḍrasānvitam
analyzed: yat bhakṣayati bhuṅkte vā vidhivat ca api mānavaḥ anyat ca kiñcid pibati tat sarvam ṣaṣ rasa anvitam

original: 1.28.2 pathyāpathyam abodhāryaṃ, tasmād bhojyaṃ śarīriṇām | rasato vīryataś caiva pravakṣyāmy ata uttaram
analyzed: pathya apathyam a bodha āryam tasmāt bhojyam śarīriṇām rasataḥ vīryataḥ ca eva pravakṣyāmi atas uttaram

original: 1.28.3 śālayo madhurāḥ sarve vipāke kaṭukāḥ smṛtāḥ | raktaśālirvaras teṣāmaraukṣyāl lekhano na ca
analyzed: śālayaḥ madhurāḥ sarve vipāke kaṭukāḥ smṛtāḥ raktaśāliḥ varaḥ teṣām araukṣyāt lekhanaḥ na ca

original: 1.28.4 dīrghaśūko mahāśāliḥ sugandhiḥ śālikāmukhaḥ | kṛṣṇavrīhiḥ kāñcanakaḥ lopārkṣaḥ śītabhīrukaḥ
analyzed: dīrghaśūkaḥ mahāśāliḥ sugandhiḥ śālikāmukhaḥ kṛṣṇavrīhiḥ kāñcanakaḥ lopārkṣaḥ śītabhīrukaḥ

original: 1.28.5 hāyano lodhraśāliś ca raktaśāliguṇānvitaḥ | pūrvapūrvo laghutaraḥpathyaḥ kiṃca bhavatyataḥ
analyzed: hāyanaḥ lodhra śāliḥ ca raktaśāli guṇa anvitaḥ pūrva pūrvaḥ laghutaraḥ pathyaḥ kiṃca bhavati atas

original: 1.28.6 sugandhakā gandhavanto gandhena madayantyatha | raukṣyāc cakalamaṃ vidyādadhikaṃ vai viśeṣataḥ
analyzed: sugandhakāḥ gandhavantaḥ gandhena madayanti atha raukṣyāt cakalamam vidyāt adhikam vai viśeṣataḥ

original: 1.28.7 kaṣāyas tv adhikaḥ kiṃcit ṣaṣṭikāḥ śālibhiḥ samāḥ | mahādoṣāḥ suguravaḥ pāṭalāvrīhayas tathā
analyzed: kaṣāyaḥ tu adhikaḥ kiṃcid ṣaṣṭikāḥ śālibhiḥ samāḥ mahā doṣāḥ su guravaḥ pāṭalā vrīhayaḥ tathā

original: 1.28.8 yavakā nityam ahitāḥ kṛṣṇavrīhipramodakāḥ | vīryoṣṇā madhurāste vai sakaṣāyāś ca kīrtitāḥ
analyzed: yavakāḥ nityam ahitāḥ kṛṣṇavrīhi pramodakāḥ vīrya uṣṇāḥ madhurāḥ te vai sakaṣāyāḥ ca kīrtitāḥ

original: 1.28.9 bahūrūkṣāḥ kaṣāyāś ca koradūṣāḥ savāruṇāḥ | prasādhikāḥ kaṃgavaś ca śyāmākāś ca samā rasaiḥ
analyzed: kaṣāyāḥ ca koradūṣāḥ sa vāruṇāḥ prasādhikāḥ kaṃgavaḥ ca śyāmākāḥ ca samāḥ rasaiḥ

original: 1.28.10uddālakās tu saṃkhyātāḥ kaṣāyā madhurā rase | grīṣmetu sevitāste vai kopayanty āśu mārutān
analyzed: uddālakāḥ tu saṃkhyātāḥ kaṣāyāḥ madhurāḥ rase sevitāḥ te vai kopayanti āśu mārutān

original: 1.28.11 yavās tv atiyavāś caiva godhūmāś ca samā rase | madhurāḥ sakaṣāyāś caśleṣmalā lohitā nṛṇām
analyzed: yavāḥ tu atiyavāḥ ca eva godhūmāḥ ca samāḥ rase madhurāḥ sakaṣāyāḥ ca śleṣmalāḥ lohitāḥ nṛṇām

original: 1.28.12 atha veṇuyavānātikaṣāyā madhurā rase | kaphaṃ pittaṃ ca medaś ca kopayantyatisevitāḥ
analyzed: atha veṇuyavāna ati kaṣāyāḥ madhurāḥ rase kapham pittam ca medaḥ ca kopayanti atisevitāḥ

original: 1.28.13 kṛṣṇā mudgā mahāmudgāḥ haritāścirajīvinaḥ | makuṣṭhakāś ca te ' pyuktāḥ kaṣāyā madhurā rase
analyzed: kṛṣṇāḥ mudgāḥ mahāmudgāḥ haritāḥ cirajīvinaḥ makuṣṭhakāḥ ca te kaṣāyāḥ madhurāḥ rase

original: 1.28.14 hareṇavo masūrāś ca satīnāś ca tathāḍhakī | kulutthāś ca viseṣeṇa kaṣāyamadhurā rase
analyzed: hareṇavaḥ masūrāḥ ca satīnāḥ ca tathā āḍhakī kulutthāḥ ca viseṣeṇa kaṣāya madhurāḥ rase

original: 1.28.15 sarve tu lavaṇakṣārā dīpanīyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | avṛṣyāś ca viśeṣeṇa durbalānāṃ hitāna ca
analyzed: sarve tu lavaṇa kṣārāḥ dīpanīyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ avṛṣyāḥ ca viśeṣeṇa durbalānām ca

original: 1.28.16 śvadaṃṣṭrā yāvanālaś ca dvau kṣārau śītalau(?) smṛtau | śuklaṃvinihatastau tu dṛṣṭiṃ cāpi śarīriṇām
analyzed: śvadaṃṣṭrā yau anālaḥ ca dvau kṣārau śītalau smṛtau śuklam vinihataḥ tau tu dṛṣṭim ca api śarīriṇām

original: 1.28.17 navanītaṃ tathāmlaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ vai madhuraṃ smṛtam | sarvaṃ dugdhamabhiṣyandi gavyaṃ tebhyo viśiṣyate
analyzed: navanītam tathā amlam tu ghṛtam vai madhuram smṛtam sarvam dugdham abhiṣyandi gavyam tebhyaḥ viśiṣyate

original: 1.28.18 vājī bhavati dugdhena balaṃ cātyupajāyate | sañjīvanaṃ sambhavati sarvaṃ kṣīramudāhṛtam
analyzed: vājī bhavati dugdhena balam ca atyupajāyate sañjīvanam sambhavati sarvam kṣīram udāhṛtam

original: 1.28.19 rase pāke ca madhuraṃ tailaṃ sarvaṃ prakīrtītam | yasminyasminviśeṣas tu yo yastasminnibodha tam
analyzed: rase pāke ca madhuram tailam sarvam prakīrtītam yasmin yasmin viśeṣaḥ tu yaḥ yaḥ tasmin nibodha tam

original: 1.28.20 tailameraṇḍabilvānāmuṣṇaṃ vātaharaṃ smṛtam | ity uktānyuṣṇavīryāṇi yadanyacchītam eva tat
analyzed: tailam eraṇḍa bilvānām uṣṇam vāta haram smṛtam iti uktāni uṣṇa vīryāṇi yat anyat śītam eva tat

original: 1.28.21 vibhītakānāṃ tailaṃ tu kaṣāyamadhuraṃ rase | kaphapittaharaṃ proktaṃ keśyaṃ caiva śarīriṇām
analyzed: vibhītakānām tailam tu kaṣāya madhuram rase kapha pitta haram proktam keśyam ca eva śarīriṇām

original: 1.28.22 ataḥ karañjabījānāṃ vijñeyāni tathaiva ca | tailāni rasato vidyāt tiktāni madhurāṇi ca
analyzed: atas karañja bījānām vijñeyāni tathā eva ca tailāni rasataḥ vidyāt tiktāni madhurāṇi ca

original: 1.28.23pittaśleṣmakaraṃtiktamiṅgudītailamucyate | sakaṣāyaṃ madhūkānāṃ kaphapittānilāpaham
analyzed: ucyate

original: 1.28.24kaulakaṃ madhurasparśaṃ rasato ' tha vipākataḥ | yasminyasminviśeṣas tu yo yastaṃ me nibodhata
analyzed: madhura sparśam vipākataḥ yasmin yasmin viśeṣaḥ tu yaḥ yaḥ tam me nibodhata

original: 1.28.25 palālajātaṃ chvākamatīva guru sammatam | mahādoṣamabhiṣyandi sukhaṃ bāhyopaghātakam(?)
analyzed: palāla jātam chvākam atīva guru sammatam mahā doṣam abhiṣyandi sukham bāhya upaghātakam

original: 1.28.26 chatrākaṃgomayodbhūtaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ rase | kaṣāyaṃ veṇucchatrākaṃ mārutaṃ kopayennṛṇām
analyzed: chatrākam gomaya udbhūtam kaṣāya madhuram rase kaṣāyam veṇucchatrākam mārutam kopayet nṛṇām

original: 1.28.27 sarvaṃ tu śākaṃ madhuraṃ rasato ' tha vipākataḥ | yasminyasminviśeṣas tu yo yastasminnibodhatam
analyzed: sarvam tu śākam madhuram vipākataḥ yasmin yasmin viśeṣaḥ tu yaḥ yaḥ tasmin nibodhatam

original: 1.28.28 mārutaṃ kopayennṝṇāṃ viṣṭambhitvād alāvukam | śleṣmāṇaṃ vardhayec cāpi vipākena balīyasā
analyzed: mārutam kopayet nṝṇām viṣṭambhi tvāt alāvukam śleṣmāṇam vardhayet ca api vipākena balīyasā

original: 1.28.29 kūṣmāṇḍaṃ śleṣmalaṃ vidyānnavaṃ śaradi bhakṣitam | tadalpadoṣaṃ bhavati parisaṃvatsaroṣitam
analyzed: kūṣmāṇḍam śleṣmalam vidyāt navam śaradi bhakṣitam tat alpa doṣam bhavati parisaṃvatsara uṣitam

original: 1.28.30 kaṣāyamadhuraṃ vidyāt khādiraṃ cātisāri ca | tiktaṃ dīpanasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ nirdoṣaṃ taccharīriṇām
analyzed: kaṣāya madhuram vidyāt khādiram ca atisāri ca tiktam dīpana saṃsṛṣṭam nirdoṣam tat śarīriṇām

original: 1.28.31 kośātakīkarīrāṇāṃ śatāvaryāś ca tiktakam | kaṣāyaṃ nālikāyāś ca tiktaḥ puṣkaravartakaḥ
analyzed: kośātakī karīrāṇām śatāvaryāḥ ca tiktakam kaṣāyam nālikāyāḥ ca tiktaḥ puṣkaravartakaḥ

original: 1.28.32 vetrāgraṃ tiktakaṃ nimbaṃ tilaśākaṃ ca śītikā | kurūṭikā kunaṭikātathā gandharvahastakaḥ
analyzed: vetra agram tiktakam nimbam tila śākam ca śītikā kurūṭikā kunaṭikā tathā gandharvahastakaḥ

original: 1.28.33 tathānāḍīkalāyaś ca pañcāṅgulyas tathaiva ca | etāni vidyācchākāni tiktāni rasapākataḥ
analyzed: tathā ānāḍīkalāyaḥ ca pañca aṅgulyaḥ tathā eva ca etāni vidyāt śākāni tiktāni rasa pākataḥ

original: 1.28.34 satīnaśākaṃ madhuramīṣatiktopasaṃhitam | kovidārasya śākaṃ tu pūrveṇaivasamaṃ matam
analyzed: satīna śākam madhuram īṣat tikta upasaṃhitam kovidārasya śākam tu pūrveṇa eva samam matam

original: 1.28.35 vārtākīnāṃ phalaṃ tiktaṃ kaṭukenopasaṃhitam | grahaṇīṃ dīpayatyetacchaleṣmāṇaṃ vinihanti ca
analyzed: vārtākīnām phalam tiktam kaṭukena upasaṃhitam grahaṇīm dīpayati etat śaleṣmāṇam vinihanti ca

original: 1.28.36kaṭhillabakulau caivamadhurau śukraśodhanau | hatastandrāṃ ca vātaṃ canityam eva viṣūcikām
analyzed: kaṭhilla bakulau ca eva madhurau śukra śodhanau hataḥ tandrām ca vātam ca nityam eva viṣūcikām

original: 1.28.37 alambusaḥ sakaṭukastiktako vātakopanaḥ | bhinatti kaphasaṅghātaṃviṣṭabhyātha vipacyate
analyzed: alambuṣaḥ sa kaṭukaḥ tiktakaḥ vāta kopanaḥ bhinatti kapha saṅghātam viṣṭabhya atha vipacyate

original: 1.28.38 lāṅgaśākaṃ tu madhuraṃ lavaṇenopasaṃhitam | kaṭukaṃ bahudoṣaṃ ca tathā pakṣanikācanam(?)
analyzed: lāṅga śākam tu madhuram lavaṇena upasaṃhitam kaṭukam bahu doṣam ca tathā pakṣa nikācanam

original: 1.28.39 kaṭuko dīpanīyaś ca viṣahā svastiko rase | kaṣāyamadhurā cillī cuñcurmadhuraśītalaḥ
analyzed: kaṭukaḥ dīpanīyaḥ ca viṣa hā svastikaḥ rase kaṣāya madhurā cillī cuñcuḥ madhura śītalaḥ

original: 1.28.40 bhārṅgī māṣaś ca madhurau rasataḥ parikīrtitau | mudgaśākaṃ satiktaṃ tu sakṣāraś caiva vāstukaḥ
analyzed: bhārṅgī māṣaḥ ca madhurau rasataḥ parikīrtitau mudga śākam sa tiktam tu sa kṣāraḥ ca eva vāstukaḥ

original: 1.28.41 niṣpāvaśākaṃ madhuraṃ māṣaśākaṃtathā smṛtam | candrākaśākamamlaṃ tu kaṣāyas tu gavedhukaḥ
analyzed: niṣpāva śākam madhuram māṣa śākam tathā smṛtam candrāka śākam amlam tu kaṣāyaḥ tu gavedhukaḥ

original: 1.28.42tunnakaṃ prapunāṭaś ca jīvantī suniṣaṇṇakam | madhurāṇyalpadoṣāṇi tathaiva tu kuṭiñjakaḥ
analyzed: tunnakam prapunāṭaḥ ca jīvantī suniṣaṇṇakam madhurāṇi alpa doṣāṇi tathā eva tu kuṭiñjakaḥ

original: 1.28.43 piṇḍāluśākaṃ ca navaṃtuṇḍikeraphalāni ca | madhurāṇyalpadoṣāṇi saṃsṛṣṭakaṭukāni ca
analyzed: piṇḍālu śākam ca navaṃtuṇḍikera phalāni ca madhurāṇi alpa doṣāṇi saṃsṛṣṭa kaṭukāni ca

original: 1.28.44 upodakā tu madhurā lavaṇenopasaṃhitā | ity etannirdiśecchākaṃ yadanyadapi tadvidham
analyzed: upodakā tu madhurā lavaṇena upasaṃhitāḥ iti etat nirdiśet śākam yat anyat api tadvidham

original: 1.28.45 ājaṃgavyamathaurabhraṃ vārāhaṃ caiva yatsmṛtam | hastimāṃsaṃ ca madhuramuṣṭraṃ guru ca nirdiśet
analyzed: ājaṃgavyam atha aurabhram vārāham ca eva yat smṛtam hasti māṃsam ca madhuram uṣṭram guru ca nirdiśet

original: 1.28.46 vidyādevaṃguṇaṃ caiva sakaṣāyaṃ ca māhiṣam | khaḍgamāṃsamabhiṣyandi sasvādulavaṇaṃ rase
analyzed: vidyāt evaṃguṇam ca eva sakaṣāyam ca māhiṣam khaḍga māṃsam abhiṣyandi sa svādu lavaṇam rase

original: 1.28.47 kutamāyurmayūraśca gokarṇo gavayo guruḥ | sṛmaraścamaro nyaṅkurmadhurā guravaś ca te
analyzed: kutamāyuḥ mayūraḥ ca gokarṇaḥ gavayaḥ guruḥ sṛmaraḥ camaraḥ nyaṅkuḥ madhurāḥ guravaḥ ca te

original: 1.28.48 ṛśyaś ca mṛgamātā ca tuṅgaś ca hariṇī mṛgaḥ | pārāvata || iti bhele aṣṭāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthānaṃ samāptam || nidānasthānam || dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ
analyzed: ṛśyaḥ ca mṛgamātā ca tuṅgaḥ ca hariṇī mṛgaḥ pārāvataḥ iti bhele aṣṭāviṃśaḥ dhyāyaḥ iti bhela saṃhitāyām sūtrasthānam samāptam nidānasthānam dvitīyaḥ dhyāyaḥ

original: 2.2.1 urovighātāttasyāthajvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate | svaraḥ sīdati cāpy asya niṣṭhīvati saśoṇitam
analyzed: uraḥ vighātāt tasya atha jvaraḥ kāsaḥ ca jāyate svaraḥ sīdati ca api asya niṣṭhīvati sa śoṇitam

original: 2.2.2 athavāpyavaśo jantuḥ śaśvatsa parihīyate | ity etairlakṣaṇairvidyāt sāhasaprabhavaṃ kṣayam
analyzed: athavā api avaśaḥ jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate iti etaiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ vidyāt sāhasa prabhavam kṣayam

original: 2.2.3 yāvatsa balavānevabṛṃhayet tāvadeva tam | yasmād balasamāveśaṃ puruṣasyeha jīvitam
analyzed: yāvat sa balavān eva bṛṃhayet tāvat eva tam yasmāt bala samāveśam puruṣasya iha jīvitam

original: 2.2.4 sa yadā gurumadhye vāpy athavā rājasaṃsadi | goṣṭhe strīdyūtamadhye vā hastipṛṣṭhe ' thavā rathe
analyzed: sa yadā guru madhye vā api athavā rāja saṃsadi goṣṭhe strī dyūta madhye vā hasti pṛṣṭhe rathe

original: 2.2.5 bhayāt prasaṅgāc cahriyā ghṛṇitvād vāpi mānavaḥ | prāptapātaṃ purīṣaṃ vā mūtraṃ vāpi ruṇaddhi yaḥ
analyzed: bhayāt prasaṅgāt ca hriyāḥ ghṛṇi tvāt vā api mānavaḥ prāpta pātam purīṣam vā mūtram vā api ruṇaddhi yaḥ

original: 2.2.6 tasya sandhāraṇādvāyurūrdhvabhāge samīritaḥ | uraḥśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ gulmaṃ ca janayatyatha
analyzed: tasya sandhāraṇāt vāyuḥ ūrdhva bhāge samīritaḥ uraḥ śūlam pārśva śūlam gulmam ca janayati atha

original: 2.2.7 gulmajanmanimittaś ca jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate | svaraḥ prabhidyate cāsya niṣṭhīvati sapūtikam
analyzed: gulma janma nimittaḥ ca jvaraḥ kāsaḥ ca jāyate svaraḥ prabhidyate ca asya niṣṭhīvati sa pūtikam

original: 2.2.8 athavāpyavaśo jantuḥ śaśvatsa parihīyate | ity ebhir lakṣaṇair vidyāt sandhāraṇakṛtaṃ kṣayam
analyzed: athavā api avaśaḥ jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate iti ebhiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ vidyāt sandhāraṇa kṛtam kṣayam

original: 2.2.9 ātmārthaṃ lajjate janturgurorvā strījanasya ca | tasmād ātmārthameveha prāptaṃ vegaṃ na dhārayet
analyzed: ātma artham lajjate jantuḥ guroḥ vā strī janasya ca tasmāt ātma artham eva iha prāptam vegam na dhārayet

original: 2.2.10 sa yadā durbalo jantuḥsvalpāhāraḥ kṛśo ' pi vā | rūkṣabhojī viśeṣeṇa striyo yaś cātisevate
analyzed: sa yadā durbalaḥ jantuḥ su alpa āhāraḥ vā rūkṣa bhojī viśeṣeṇa striyaḥ yaḥ ca atisevate

original: 2.2.11 saraktaṃ kurute mūtraṃ jantuḥ śuklaparikṣayāt | retaḥsthānaṃ ca suṣiraṃ vāyurasya pradhāvati
analyzed: sa raktam kurute mūtram jantuḥ śukla parikṣayāt retaḥ sthānam ca suṣiram vāyuḥ asya pradhāvati

original: 2.2.12 tasya vātābhibhūtasya jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate | svaraḥ sīdati cāpy asya niṣṭhīvati saśoṇitam
analyzed: tasya vāta abhibhūtasya jvaraḥ kāsaḥ ca jāyate svaraḥ sīdati ca api asya niṣṭhīvati sa śoṇitam

original: 2.2.13 athavāpyavaśo jantuḥ śaśvatsa parihīyate | ity ebhir lakṣaśairvidyādatimaithunajaṃ kṣayam
analyzed: athavā api avaśaḥ jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate iti ebhiḥ lakṣaśaiḥ vidyāt ati maithuna jam kṣayam

original: 2.2.14 ratimūlaṃ śarīraṃ hi śarīrasya ratiḥ phalam | tasmāt phalārthī mūlārthaṃ striyaḥ seveta yuktitaḥ
analyzed: rati mūlam śarīram hi śarīrasya ratiḥ phalam tasmāt phala arthī mūla artham striyaḥ seveta yuktitaḥ

original: 2.2.15 sa yadā durbalo jantuḥ sevate viṣamāśanam | bhuñjānasyāsya viṣamaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ yānti dhātavaḥ
analyzed: sa yadā durbalaḥ jantuḥ sevate viṣama aśanam bhuñjānasya asya viṣamam vaiṣamyam yānti dhātavaḥ

original: 2.2.16 tataḥ purīṣameveha vardhayatyasya bhojanam | nāvāpnoti rasaṃ dehevikṛtasyeva dehinaḥ
analyzed: tatas purīṣam eva iha vardhayati asya bhojanam na avāpnoti rasam dehevikṛtasya iva dehinaḥ

original: 2.2.17 rase nivṛtte tasyātha jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate | svaraḥ sīdati cāpy asya niṣṭhīvatisaśoṇitam
analyzed: rase nivṛtte tasya atha jvaraḥ kāsaḥ ca jāyate svaraḥ sīdati ca api asya niṣṭhīvati sa śoṇitam

original: 2.2.18 athavāpyavaśo jantuḥ śaśvatsa parihīyate | ity ebhir lakṣaṇairvidyādviṣamāśanajaṃ kṣayam
analyzed: athavā api avaśaḥ jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate iti ebhiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ vidyāt viṣama aśana jam kṣayam

original: 2.2.19yasmādarthī śarīrārthaṃ rasabhojanamicchati | śarīrāpekṣayā tasmād āhāraṃ susamācaret
analyzed: yasmāt arthī śarīra artham rasa bhojanam icchati śarīra apekṣayā tasmāt āhāram su samācaret

original: 2.2.20 iti catvāri śoṣāṇāmuktānyāyatanāni me | yāni buddhvā pariharedārogyārthī pumāniha | buddhaucārogyamāyattamidamuktaṃ maharṣiṇā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele nidāne dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || || tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto gulmanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: iti catvāri śoṣāṇām uktāni āyatanāni me yāni buddhvā pariharet ārogya arthī pumān iha buddha āveca ārogyam āyattam idam uktam mahā ṛṣiṇā iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele nidāne dvitīyaḥ dhyāyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas gulmanidānam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 2.3.1 vātātpittātkaphāccaiva nicayādatha lohitāt | pañca gulmābhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: vātāt pittāt kaphāt ca eva nicayāt atha lohitāt pañca gulmāḥ bhavanti iha teṣām vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.3.2 sa yadāvātalojanturvātalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | dhāvati plavate vāpi rātrau jāgarti vā punaḥ
analyzed: sa yadā avātalaḥ jantuḥ vātalam bhajate śanam dhāvati plavate vā api rātrau jāgarti vā punar
R

original: 2.3.3atibrūte ' tihasati striyo vātiniṣevate | udāvartayate vāpi karmacātiniṣevate
analyzed: striyaḥ vā atiniṣevate udāvartayate vā api karma ca atiniṣevate
R

original: 2.3.4 vṛkṣaprapatanādvāpi chardayatyathavā balāt | tasyaivaṃ kupito vāyur āmāśayamupāgataḥ
analyzed: vṛkṣa prapatanāt vā api chardayati athavā balāt tasya evam kupitaḥ vāyuḥ āmāśayam upāgataḥ

original: 2.3.5 pārśvayor hṛdikukṣau vā gulmaṃ saṃjanayatyatha | sa sakṛdbhavati sthūlaḥ punar bhavati vāpy aṇuḥ
analyzed: pārśvayoḥ hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmam saṃjanayati atha sa sakṛt bhavati sthūlaḥ punar bhavati vā api aṇuḥ

original: 2.3.6 todasphuraṇasaṃyukto vidhyate ca vidhāvati | vedanāṃ janayatyeṣa jvaraṃ sañjanayaty api
analyzed: toda sphuraṇa saṃyuktaḥ vidhyate ca vidhāvati vedanām janayati eṣa jvaram sañjanayati api

original: 2.3.7 vastiśīrṣaṃ ca saṃgṛhya dārayanniva tiṣṭhati | viṣaṃ bhavati cāhāro mūrdhānaṃ pratipadyate
analyzed: vastiśīrṣam ca saṃgṛhya dārayan iva tiṣṭhati viṣam bhavati ca āhāraḥ mūrdhānam pratipadyate

original: 2.3.8 punaś ca dṛśyate vyaktaṃ punarnaśyati cāpy atha | karoti gāḍhaṃ duḥkhena purīṣaṃ vāsaśoṇitam
analyzed: punar ca dṛśyate vyaktam punar naśyati ca api atha karoti gāḍham duḥkhena purīṣam vāsa śoṇitam

original: 2.3.9kṛṣṇābhāsaś ca puruṣovātagulmī sa dṛśyate | yassadā pittalojantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate ' śanam
analyzed: kṛṣṇa ābhāsaḥ ca puruṣaḥ vāta gulmī sa dṛśyate yaḥ sadā pittalaḥ jantuḥ pittalam bhajate śanam

original: 2.3.10 apramāṇena durmedhāḥ sevatepānamīdṛśam | tasyaivaṃ kupitaṃ pittamāmāśayamupāgatam
analyzed: apramāṇena durmedhāḥ sevate īpānam īdṛśam tasya evam kupitam pittam āmāśayam upāgatam

original: 2.3.11 pārśvayor hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmaṃ sañjanayatyatha | uṣyate dūyate cāpi dahyatedhūpyate tathā
analyzed: pārśvayoḥ hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmam sañjanayati atha uṣyate dūyate ca api dahyate dhūpyate tathā

original: 2.3.12 nityaṃ taptaś ca raktaṃ ca svedaṃ muñcatyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | ayogolo yathā taptas tathā sthānagatedahet
analyzed: nityam taptaḥ ca raktam ca svedam muñcati abhīkṣṇaśas ayaḥ golaḥ yathā taptaḥ tathā sthāna gate dahet

original: 2.3.13 tṛṣṇāṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayetsthānād api visarpati | vedanā paramā caiva tasmin sthāne prajāyate
analyzed: tṛṣṇām mūrcchām ca janayet sthānāt api visarpati vedanā paramā ca eva tasmin sthāne prajāyate

original: 2.3.14 purā jātāni lomāni tasmād gulmaparigrahāt | cyavante na ca jāyante yāvadvyādhirna śāmyati
analyzed: purā jātāni lomāni tasmāt gulma parigrahāt cyavante na ca jāyante yāvat vyādhiḥ na śāmyati

original: 2.3.15 pittagulmena puruṣaḥ pītābhāsaś ca lakṣyate | yassadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam
analyzed: pitta gulmena puruṣaḥ pīta ābhāsaḥ ca lakṣyate yaḥ sadā śleṣmalaḥ jantuḥ śleṣmalam bhajate śanam

original: 2.3.16 apramāṇena durmedhā divāsvapnaratas tathā | tasyaivaṃ kupitaḥ śleṣmā hyāmāśayamupāgataḥ
analyzed: apramāṇena durmedhāḥ divāsvapna rataḥ tathā tasya evam kupitaḥ śleṣmā hi āmāśayam upāgataḥ

original: 2.3.17 pārśvayor hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmaṃ sañjanayatyatha | na cāsya svadate bhojyaṃbhuktaṃ na ca vipacyate
analyzed: pārśvayoḥ hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmam sañjanayati atha na ca asya svadate bhojyam bhuktam na ca vipacyate

original: 2.3.18 śleṣmaṇā saha bhuktaṃ ca muhurūrdhvaṃ prapadyate | śuklamūtrapurīṣaś ca śuklābhāsas tathaiva ca
analyzed: śleṣmaṇā saha bhuktam ca muhur ūrdhvam prapadyate śukla mūtra purīṣaḥ ca śukla ābhāsaḥ tathā eva ca

original: 2.3.19 śuklanetraś ca bhavati gulme śleṣmasamudbhave | yassadā karśito janturvyādhinā bheṣajena vā
analyzed: śukla netraḥ ca bhavati gulme śleṣma samudbhave yaḥ sadā karśitaḥ jantuḥ vyādhinā bheṣajena vā

original: 2.3.20 asañjātabalāgniś ca doṣalānyupasevate | tasya sannicitā doṣā gulmaṃ kurvanti dāruṇam
analyzed: a sañjāta bala agniḥ ca doṣalāni upasevate tasya sannicitāḥ doṣāḥ gulmam kurvanti dāruṇam

original: 2.3.21 tatra sarvāṇi rūpāṇi dṛśyante sānnipātike | atha lohitagulmas tu strīṇām eva prajāyate
analyzed: tatra sarvāṇi rūpāṇi dṛśyante sānnipātike atha lohita gulmaḥ tu strīṇām eva prajāyate

original: 2.3.22nāsau bhavati nṝṇāṃ tu tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam | acirapracyute garbhe sūtikāyās tathā ' cirāt
analyzed: na asau bhavati nṝṇām tu tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam acira pracyute garbhe sūtikāyāḥ tathā cirāt

original: 2.3.23 atiprajananādvāpi tathā ' prajananena vā | sandhāraṇādvābhārasya raktamādhmāpayet tataḥ
analyzed: ati prajananāt vā api tathā prajananena vā sandhāraṇāt vā ābhārasya raktam ādhmāpayet tatas

original: 2.3.24sā śoṇite sthite nārī garbhiṇī strīti manyate | samayādatha śūlāni tasyāḥ kukṣau bhavatyatha
analyzed: sā śoṇite sthite nārī garbhiṇī strī iti manyate samayāt atha śūlāni tasyāḥ kukṣau bhavati atha

original: 2.3.25 koṣṭhe gulmodaraṃ tac ca garbho ' yam iti manyate | garbho ' yam iti ca vyādhirvarṣamekaṃ bahūny api
analyzed: koṣṭhe gulmodaram tat ca garbhaḥ yam iti manyate garbhaḥ yam iti ca vyādhiḥ varṣam ekam bahūni api

original: 2.3.26 dhārayatyatha nirbhedaṃ kathañcitsanniyacchati | athāsyāḥ kālaparyāyāt sakṣīrau bhavataḥ stanau
analyzed: dhārayati atha nirbhedam kathañcid san niyacchati atha asyāḥ kāla paryāyāt sa kṣīrau bhavataḥ stanau

original: 2.3.27 kṛśā bhavatisā pāṇḍurdohadaṃ cābhinandati | chardirniṣṭhīvikā caiva tandrā caivaṃ prabādhate
analyzed: kṛśā bhavati sā pāṇḍuḥ dohadam ca abhinandati chardiḥ niṣṭhīvikā ca eva tandrā ca evam prabādhate

original: 2.3.28 pādayoḥ śvayathuś ca syādraktagulme praduṣyati | eṣāṃ tu khalu pañcānāṃ gulmānāṃ samudāhṛtam | vidyādasādhyaṃ nicayaṃyatnasādhyāṃstathetarān || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele nidāne tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || || caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ kāsanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: pādayoḥ śvayathuḥ ca syāt rakta gulme praduṣyati eṣām tu khalu pañcānām gulmānām samudāhṛtam vidyāt asādhyam nicayam yatna sādhyān tathā itarān iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele nidāne tṛtīyaḥ dhyāyaḥ caturthaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas kāsanidānam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 2.4.1 vātātpittātkaphāccaiva kṣatādvātha kṣayād api | pañcakāsā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: vātāt pittāt kaphāt ca eva kṣatāt vā atha kṣayāt api pañca kāsāḥ bhavanti iha teṣām vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.4.2 yassadā vātalo janturasātmyaṃ vai niṣevate | rūkṣamaśnāti pibati rūkṣaṃhi bahu khādati
analyzed: yaḥ sadā vātalaḥ jantuḥ asātmyam vai niṣevate rūkṣam aśnāti pibati rūkṣam hi bahu khādati

original: 2.4.3 tasya vātaḥ prakupito gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ | ūrdhvaṃ samprāpyadhamanīratha kāsāya kalpate
analyzed: tasya vātaḥ prakupitaḥ gṛhītvā hṛdayam tatas ūrdhvam samprāpya dhamanīḥ atha kāsāya kalpate

original: 2.4.4 uraḥśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ pṛṣṭhastambhaśca jāyate | āṭopyate ' syodaraṃ caśiraś cāsyātimanthyate
analyzed: uraḥ śūlam pārśva śūlam pṛṣṭha stambhaḥ ca jāyate āṭopyate ca asya atimanthyate

original: 2.4.5 uro ' bhighātātpārśve ca gṛhyete iva dehinaḥ | kaphaḥ prakāsamānasya sasaṃrambhaḥ pravartate
analyzed: uraḥ bhighātāt pārśve ca gṛhyete iva dehinaḥ kaphaḥ prakāsamānasya sa saṃrambhaḥ pravartate

original: 2.4.6 pratataṃ kāsamānasya mūtraṃvāto ruṇaddhi hi | ity ebhir lakṣaṇairvidyādvātakāsaṃ śarīriṇām
analyzed: pratatam kāsamānasya mūtraṃvātaḥ ruṇaddhi hi iti ebhiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ vidyāt vāta kāsam śarīriṇām

original: 2.4.7 yassadā pittalo janturasātmyaṃ vai niṣevate | amlamaśnāti pibati khādatyāsvādayaty api
analyzed: yaḥ sadā pittalaḥ jantuḥ asātmyam vai niṣevate amlam aśnāti pibati khādati āsvādayati api

original: 2.4.8 tasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ | ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīstataḥ kāsāya kalpate
analyzed: tasya pittam prakupitam gṛhītvā hṛdayam tatas ūrdhvam samprāpya dhamanīḥ tatas kāsāya kalpate

original: 2.4.9 uro vidahyate cāsya tathaivāpyabhitapyate | soṣmanāsaś ca bhavatidahyete cākṣiṇī tataḥ
analyzed: uraḥ vidahyate ca asya tathā eva api abhitapyate sa ūṣma nāsaḥ ca ca akṣiṇī tatas

original: 2.4.10 niṣṭhīvati sapittaṃ ca raktaṃ vā nā kadācana | mukhaṃ bhavati vā pītaṃ pittakāsena dehinaḥ
analyzed: niṣṭhīvati sa pittam ca raktam vā nā kadācana mukham bhavati vā pītam pitta kāsena dehinaḥ

original: 2.4.11 yassadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | pibatyaśnāti madhuraṃ madhuraṃvāpi khādati
analyzed: yaḥ sadā śleṣmalaḥ jantuḥ śleṣmalam bhajate śanam pibati aśnāti madhuram madhuram vā api khādati

original: 2.4.12 avyāyāmarataś cāpi divāsvapnaṃ ca sevate | tasya śleṣmā prakupito gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ
analyzed: avyāyāma rataḥ ca api divāsvapnam ca sevate tasya śleṣmā prakupitaḥ gṛhītvā hṛdayam tatas

original: 2.4.13 ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīstataḥ kāsāya kalpate | grathitaṃ śleṣmaṇā kāsaṃ niṣṭhīvati sapūtikam
analyzed: ūrdhvam samprāpya dhamanīḥ tatas kāsāya kalpate grathitam śleṣmaṇā kāsam niṣṭhīvati sa pūtikam

original: 2.4.14 duṣṭaśleṣmapratiśyāyaḥ śleṣmakāsena jāyate | sāhasaṃ karma yaḥ kṛtvāvikṣataṃ khedayatyuraḥ
analyzed: duṣṭa śleṣma pratiśyāyaḥ śleṣma kāsena jāyate sāhasam karma yaḥ kṛtvā avikṣatam khedayati uraḥ

original: 2.4.15 niṣṭhīvati saraktaṃ ca kāse kṣatasamudbhave | strīṣu saktaś ca yo jantus tasya śuklaparikṣayāt
analyzed: niṣṭhīvati sa raktam ca kāse kṣata samudbhave strīṣu saktaḥ ca yaḥ jantuḥ tasya śukla parikṣayāt

original: 2.4.16 liṅgaṃ vātābhibhūtatvāt sūcībhir iva tudyate | saraktaṃ kurute mūtraṃ tathāśuklaṃ ca lohitam
analyzed: liṅgam vāta abhibhūta tvāt sūcībhiḥ iva tudyate sa raktam kurute mūtram tathā a śuklam ca lohitam

original: 2.4.17 sarva ete samuddiṣṭāḥ kāsā lakṣaṇato mayā | tānavekṣya bhiṣag buddhyā tataḥ kuryāc cikitsitam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele nidāne caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: sarve ete samuddiṣṭāḥ kāsāḥ lakṣaṇataḥ mayā tān avekṣya bhiṣaj buddhyā tatas kuryāt cikitsitam iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti nidāne caturthaḥ dhyāyaḥ pañcamaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas kuṣṭhanidānam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 2.5.1 pippalīṃ kākamācīṃ ca likucaṃ dadhisarpiṣā | vātāyuṃ payasā sārdhaṃguḍena saha mūlakam
analyzed: pippalīm kākamācīm ca likucam dadhi sarpiṣā vātāyum payasā sārdham guḍena saha mūlakam

original: 2.5.2 anyadevaṃvidhaṃ yac ca viruddhaṃ tatsamaśnataḥ | chardiṃ pratighnataś cāpi mithyāsaṃsargasevanāt
analyzed: anyat evaṃvidham yat ca viruddham tat samaśnataḥ chardim pratighnataḥ ca api mithyā saṃsarga sevanāt

original: 2.5.3 anullikhya vidagdhaṃ ca vidāhi ca samaśnataḥ | pathi cārādviriktasya śrāntasyodakasevanāt
analyzed: an ullikhya vidagdham ca vidāhi ca samaśnataḥ pathi ca ārāt viriktasya śrāntasya udaka sevanāt

original: 2.5.4 matsyān payaś canimbūṃś ca tathaikadhyaṃ samaśnataḥ | jantossañjāyate kuṣṭhaṃ tadvidhānāṃ ca sevanāt
analyzed: matsyān payaḥ ca nimbūn ca tathā aikadhyam samaśnataḥ jantoḥ sañjāyate kuṣṭham tadvidhānām ca sevanāt

original: 2.5.5 yassadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | sevate ca divāsvapnaṃ tasya śleṣmā pravardhate
analyzed: yaḥ sadā śleṣmalaḥ jantuḥ śleṣmalam bhajate śanam sevate ca divāsvapnam tasya śleṣmā pravardhate

original: 2.5.6 sa vṛddho dūṣayatyasya māṃsaṃ tvagrudhiraṃ tathā | utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpy atha
analyzed: sa vṛddhaḥ dūṣayati asya māṃsam tvac rudhiram tathā utsādyate tvac doṣeṇa svidyate tena ca api atha

original: 2.5.7 tatra kuṣṭhāni jāyante dadru sidhmānivai punaḥ | maṇḍalāni ca citrāṇi teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: tatra kuṣṭhāni jāyante dadru sidhmāni vai punar maṇḍalāni ca citrāṇi teṣām vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.5.8 maṇḍalāni ghanānīha piṭakābhāni sarvaśaḥ | sakaṇḍūni visarpīṇi dadrukuṣṭhāni nirdiśet
analyzed: maṇḍalāni ghanāni iha piṭaka ābhāni sarvaśas sa kaṇḍūni visarpīṇi dadru kuṣṭhāni nirdiśet

original: 2.5.9 prasravanti yadā tānidoṣotsannāni dehinaḥ | tadāsya kīlaṃ koṣaṃ ca picchilaṃ saṃsravanti ca
analyzed: prasravanti yadā tāni doṣa utsannāni dehinaḥ tadā asya kīlam koṣam ca picchilam saṃsravanti ca

original: 2.5.10saṃhatāni vipāṇḍūnipaṅkiloṣṭhacitāni ca | tvagutthāni tu rūksāṇi maṇḍalāni tanūny api
analyzed: saṃhatāni ca tvac utthāni tu rūksāṇi maṇḍalāni tanūni api

original: 2.5.11 sidhmakuṣṭhāni jānīyāt tathā tāni bhavanti vai | picchilaṃ madhuvarṇaṃ cayadā doṣāḥ sravanti ca
analyzed: sidhma kuṣṭhāni jānīyāt tathā tāni bhavanti vai picchilam madhu varṇam caya dāḥ doṣāḥ sravanti ca

original: 2.5.12 maṇḍalāni ca śuklāni ghanotsannāni sarvaśaḥ | vidyānmaṇḍalakuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām
analyzed: maṇḍalāni ca śuklāni ghana utsannāni sarvaśas vidyāt maṇḍala kuṣṭhāni cira bhedīni dehinām

original: 2.5.13 yadā tu tāni bhidyante tadāśvetaṃ sravanti hi | iti śleṣmasamutthāni trīṇi kuṣṭhāni nirdiśet
analyzed: yadā tu tāni bhidyante tadā śvetam sravanti hi iti śleṣma samutthāni trīṇi kuṣṭhāni nirdiśet

original: 2.5.14 yassadā vātalo janturvātalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | vātātapau sevate ca tasyavātaḥ pravardhate
analyzed: yaḥ sadā vātalaḥ jantuḥ vātalam bhajate śanam vāta ātapau sevate ca tasyavātaḥ pravardhate

original: 2.5.15 sa vṛddho dūṣayatyasya tvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ tathā | utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpy atha
analyzed: sa vṛddhaḥ dūṣayati asya tvak māṃsa rudhiram tathā utsādyate tvac doṣeṇa svidyate tena ca api atha

original: 2.5.16 kapālakuṣṭhaṃ tenāsya praduṣṭe māṃsaśoṇite | jantorvivṛddhavātasya tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: kapāla kuṣṭham tena asya praduṣṭe māṃsa śoṇite jantoḥ vivṛddha vātasya tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.5.17 paruṣāṇyaruṇābhāni maṇḍalāni samāni ca | vidyāt kapālakuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām
analyzed: paruṣāṇi aruṇa ābhāni maṇḍalāni samāni ca vidyāt kapāla kuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām

original: 2.5.18 yassadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | vātātapau sevate ca tasya pittaṃ prakupyati
analyzed: yaḥ sadā pittalaḥ jantuḥ pittalam bhajate śanam vāta ātapau sevate ca tasya pittam prakupyati

original: 2.5.19 tad vṛddhaṃ dūṣayatyasya tvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ tadā | utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpy atha
analyzed: tat vṛddham dūṣayati asya tvak māṃsa rudhiram tadā utsādyate tvac doṣeṇa svidyate tena ca api atha

original: 2.5.20 tataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante praduṣṭe māṃsaśoṇite | pittasya parikope vā teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: tatas kuṣṭhāni jāyante praduṣṭe māṃsa śoṇite pittasya parikope vā teṣām vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.5.21 pakvodumbaravarṇāni maṇḍalānīha yāni tu | vidyādaudumbarāṇyatra tānyasādhyāni dehinām
analyzed: pakva udumbara varṇāni maṇḍalāni iha yāni tu vidyāt audumbarāṇi atra tāni asādhyāni dehinām

original: 2.5.22 prāpnuvanti yadā bhedaṃ kuṣṭhāny audumbarāṇi ca | maṇḍalīkāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni bhavanti vai
analyzed: prāpnuvanti yadā bhedam kuṣṭhāni audumbarāṇi ca maṇḍalīkāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni bhavanti vai

original: 2.5.23 maṇḍalāni ca yānīha puṇḍarīkanibhāni vai | puṇḍarīkāṇi sādhyāni tāni vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ
analyzed: maṇḍalāni ca yāni iha puṇḍarīka nibhāni vai puṇḍarīkāṇi sādhyāni tāni vidyāt vicakṣaṇaḥ

original: 2.5.24 prāpnuvanti yadā bhedaṃ puṇḍarīkāṇi yāni vai | ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni vinirdiśet
analyzed: prāpnuvanti yadā bhedam puṇḍarīkāṇi yāni vai ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni vinirdiśet

original: 2.5.25 nīlotpalasavarṇāni maṇḍalānīha rūpataḥ | ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tānyasādhyāni nirdiśet
analyzed: nīlotpala savarṇāni maṇḍalāni iha rūpataḥ ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tāni asādhyāni nirdiśet

original: 2.5.26 prāpnuvanti yadā bhedamṛśyajihvānyaśeṣataḥ | kākaṇānīti matimāṃstadā tāni vinirdiśet
analyzed: prāpnuvanti yadā bhedam ṛśya jihvāni aśeṣatas kākaṇāni iti matimān tadā tāni vinirdiśet

original: 2.5.27kākaṇantikavarṇāni maṇḍalānīha yāni tu | kākaṇānīti tānyāhuḥ pratyākhyeyāni dehinām
analyzed: maṇḍalāni iha yāni tu kākaṇāni iti tāni āhuḥ pratyākhyeyāni dehinām

original: 2.5.28 iti kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vai vyākhyātam anupūrvaśaḥ | tanniśamyeha matimān hitajīrṇāśano bhavet || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele nidāne pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: iti kuṣṭhanidānam vai vyākhyātam anupūrvaśas tat niśamya iha matimān hita jīrṇa aśanaḥ bhavet iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele nidāne pañcamaḥ dhyāyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas pramehanidānam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 2.6.1 prakṛtiprabhavaś caiva narasya svakṛtas tathā | jñeyaḥ prameho dvividhas tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: prakṛti prabhavaḥ ca eva narasya sva kṛtaḥ tathā jñeyaḥ pramehaḥ dvividhaḥ tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.6.2 ślakṣṇāṅgā mṛdavaḥ snigdhā bhṛśaṃ śleṣmalamedurāḥ | jātapramehā nardanti matsyamāṃsocitā narāḥ
analyzed: ślakṣṇa aṅgāḥ mṛdavaḥ snigdhāḥ bhṛśam śleṣmala medurāḥ jāta pramehāḥ nardanti matsya māṃsa ucitāḥ narāḥ

original: 2.6.3 mātāpitṛbhyāmīdṛgbhyāṃ janito yas tu mānavaḥ | medaḥśithilanāttasya prakṛtyā sa tu mehati
analyzed: mātā pitṛbhyām īdṛgbhyām janitaḥ yaḥ tu mānavaḥ medaḥ śithilanāt tasya prakṛtyā sa tu mehati

original: 2.6.4 anūpajānāṃ susnigdhairvividhaiś cāpi vārijaiḥ | gavyājaurabhramāṃsaiś ca sadyo dadhnā ghṛtena vā
analyzed: anūpa jānām su snigdhaiḥ vividhaiḥ ca api vāri jaiḥ gavya āja aurabhra māṃsaiḥ ca sadyas dadhnā ghṛtena vā

original: 2.6.5 guḍaprakāraiḥ payasāpalalenaudakaiḥ khagaiḥ | avyāyāmāddivāsvapnātsukhaśayyāsanāttathā
analyzed: guḍa prakāraiḥ payasā apalalena audakaiḥ khagaiḥ avyāyāmāt divāsvapnāt sukha śayyā āsanāt tathā

original: 2.6.6 ity ebhir īdṛśaiś cānyairmedaḥ snigdhaiḥ pravardhate | medaḥ pravṛddhaṃdehaṃ ca vastiṃ ca kledayaty api
analyzed: iti ebhiḥ īdṛśaiḥ ca anyaiḥ medaḥ snigdhaiḥ pravardhate medaḥ pravṛddham deham ca vastim ca kledayati api

original: 2.6.7 yassadā medasā klinnaḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | tasya prakupitaḥ śleṣmā pramehān kurute daśa
analyzed: yaḥ sadā medasā klinnaḥ śleṣmalam bhajate tasya prakupitaḥ śleṣmā pramehān kurute daśa

original: 2.6.8 tad yathodakamehaṃ ca piṣṭamehaṃ tathaiva ca | evamādīṃstathānyāṃś ca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: tat yathā udakameham ca piṣṭameham tathā eva ca evamādīn tathā anyān ca teṣām vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.6.9 sphaṭikāmbunibhaṃ mūtramudamehī pramehati | śuklapiṣṭanibhaṃ cāpi piṣṭamehī pramehati
analyzed: sphaṭika ambu nibham mūtram udamehī pramehati śukla piṣṭa nibham ca api piṣṭamehī pramehati

original: 2.6.10kāṇḍekṣurasamehī ca mehatīkṣurasopamam | mūtraṃ śuklopamaṃ cāpi śuklamehī tu mehati
analyzed: kāṇḍa ikṣu rasa mehī ca mehati ikṣu rasa upamam mūtram śukla upamam ca api śuklamehī tu mehati

original: 2.6.11 ity etāṃścaturo mehāñ jānīyāt kevalātkaphāt | śleṣmaṇyanubale pitte ye mehanti tu tāñchṛṇu
analyzed: iti etān caturaḥ mehān jānīyāt kevalāt kaphāt śleṣmaṇi anubale pitte ye mehanti tu tān śṛṇu

original: 2.6.12 lavaṇāmbunibhaṃ mūtraṃ vidyāllavaṇamehinaḥ | pramehati tathā jantussurāmehī surākṛti || mūtraṃ sāndraṃ prasannaṃ tu dṛśyate sāndramehinaḥ | iti bhele nidāne ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ || .. .. gītāni bhajate nityaṃ pittonmādanipīḍitaḥ
analyzed: lavaṇa ambu nibham mūtram vidyāt lavaṇamehinaḥ pramehati tathā jantuḥ surāmehī surā ākṛti mūtram sāndram prasannam tu dṛśyate sāndramehinaḥ iti bhele nidāne ṣaṣṭhaḥ dhyāyaḥ saptamaḥ dhyāyaḥ gītāni bhajate nityam pitta unmāda nipīḍitaḥ

original: 2.7.1 yassadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | sevate ca divāsvapnaṃ tasya śleṣmā pravardhate
analyzed: yaḥ sadā śleṣmalaḥ jantuḥ śleṣmalam bhajate sevate ca divāsvapnam tasya śleṣmā pravardhate

original: 2.7.2 sa vṛddha ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīrdaśa | ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ
analyzed: sa vṛddhaḥ ūrdhvam hṛdayāt gṛhītvā dhamanīḥ daśa ruddhvā cetaḥ vaham mārgam saṃjñām bhraṃśayate tatas

original: 2.7.3 sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ puruṣastāni tāni viceṣṭate | gāyannṛtyati caikatra hasatyatha ca roditi
analyzed: sa bhraṣṭa saṃjñaḥ puruṣaḥ tāni tāni viceṣṭate gāyan nṛtyati ca ekatra hasati atha ca roditi

original: 2.7.4 ekatrāste vinā lokaṃśete cāpi jaḍo yathā | janaṃbhīṣayate cāpi śleṣmonmādī pumāniha
analyzed: ekatra āste vinā lokam śete ca api jaḍaḥ yathā janam bhīṣayate ca api śleṣma unmādī pumān iha

original: 2.7.5 yas tv etat sarvamaśnāti yathoktaṃ doṣakopanam | sannipātāttathonmādaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ sa ṛcchati
analyzed: yaḥ tu etat sarvam aśnāti yathā uktam doṣa kopanam sannipātāt tathā unmādam sarva liṅgam saḥ ṛcchati

original: 2.7.6 sa yadā dhananāśena maraṇena priyasya vā | atha cintayate, tasya saṃjñā bhraśyati cintayā
analyzed: sa yadā dhana nāśena maraṇena priyasya vā atha cintayate tasya saṃjñā bhraśyati cintayā

original: 2.7.7 sa cintayati yānbhāvāṃstāneva pralapatyatha | āgantuṃ pañcamaṃ vidyādity unmādaṃ śarīriṇām
analyzed: sa cintayati yān bhāvān tān eva pralapati atha āgantum pañcamam vidyāt iti unmādam śarīriṇām

original: 2.7.8 sarvān etān vijānīyādunmādānvai cikitsitāt | duḥkhenasaṃjñābhraṣṭo hi prakṛtiṃ punar ṛcchati
analyzed: sarvān etān vijānīyāt unmādān vai cikitsitāt duḥkhena saṃjñā bhraṣṭaḥ hi prakṛtim punar ṛcchati

original: 2.7.9 evaṃ śarīrajā doṣāḥ śarīre paryavasthitāḥ | śarīram eva hiṃsanti pāvakaḥ svamivāśrayam
analyzed: evam śarīra jāḥ doṣāḥ śarīre paryavasthitāḥ śarīram eva hiṃsanti pāvakaḥ svam iva āśrayam

original: 2.7.10na hi satvāni hiṃsanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ | devās tathā dharmaśīlāḥ madhyasthā manujānprati
analyzed: na hi satvāni hiṃsanti na piśācāḥ na rākṣasāḥ devāḥ tathā dharma śīlāḥ madhyasthāḥ manujān prati

original: 2.7.11 vamane recane yuktonirūhe cānuvāsane | na jātu dāruṇān rogānunmādān prāpnuyān naraḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele nidāne saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ || || aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' pasmāranidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: vamane recane ca anuvāsane na jātu dāruṇān rogān unmādān prāpnuyāt naraḥ iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti nidāne saptamaḥ dhyāyaḥ aṣṭamaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas upasmāranidānam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 2.8.1 vātātpittātkaphāccaiva sannipātāttathaiva ca | apasmārā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
analyzed: vātāt pittāt kaphāt ca eva sannipātāt tathā eva ca apasmārāḥ bhavanti iha teṣām vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

original: 2.8.2 yassadā vātalo janturvātalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | vyāyāmaṃ sevate cāpi tasya vātaḥ prakupyati
analyzed: yaḥ sadā vātalaḥ jantuḥ vātalam bhajate śanam vyāyāmam sevate ca api tasya vātaḥ prakupyati

original: 2.8.3 sa vṛddha ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīrdaśa | ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ
analyzed: sa vṛddhaḥ ūrdhvam hṛdayāt gṛhītvā dhamanīḥ daśa ruddhvā cetaḥ vaham mārgam saṃjñām bhraṃśayate tatas

original: 2.8.4 sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ patati dantānkaṭakaṭāyate | utphālayati netre cabhruvau prakṣipate tathā
analyzed: sa bhraṣṭa saṃjñaḥ patati dantān kaṭakaṭāyate utphālayati netre ca bhruvau prakṣipate tathā

original: 2.8.5 sa cetpratyāgato brūyāt tamasaḥ parato gataḥ | pratibhāti ca me kṛṣṇā jagatī khaṇḍaśas tathā
analyzed: sa ced pratyāgataḥ brūyāt tamasaḥ paratas gataḥ pratibhāti ca me kṛṣṇā jagatī khaṇḍaśas tathā

original: 2.8.6 tadordhvamevaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāyurvarcopadhāvati | ity etairlakṣaṇairvidyādapasmāraṃ tu vātajam
analyzed: tadā ūrdhvam evam hṛdayam vāyuḥ varcaḥ upadhāvati iti etaiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ vidyāt apasmāram tu vāta jam

original: 2.8.7 yassadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate ' śanam | agnyātapau sevate ca tasya pittaṃ pravardhate
analyzed: yaḥ sadā pittalaḥ jantuḥ pittalam bhajate śanam agni ātapau sevate ca tasya pittam pravardhate

original: 2.8.8 tad vṛddhamūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīrdaśa | ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ
analyzed: tat vṛddham ūrdhvam hṛdayāt gṛhītvā dhamanīḥ daśa ruddhvā cetaḥ vaham mārgam saṃjñām bhraṃśayate tatas

original: 2.8.9 sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ patati dantānkaṭakaṭāyate | utphālayati netre ca bhruvāvutkṣipate tathā
analyzed: sa bhraṣṭa saṃjñaḥ patati dantān kaṭakaṭāyate utphālayati netre ca bhruvau utkṣipate tathā

original: 2.8.10 sa cetpratyāgato brūyāt tamasaḥ parato gataḥ | pratibhāti ca me śuklā jagatī khaṇḍaśas tathā
analyzed: sa ced pratyāgataḥ brūyāt tamasaḥ paratas gataḥ pratibhāti ca me śuklā jagatī khaṇḍaśas tathā

original: 2.8.11 tadordhvamevaṃ hṛdayaṃkapho varcopadhāvati | ity etairlakṣaṇairvidyādapasmāraṃ kaphātmakam
analyzed: tadā ūrdhvam evam hṛdayaṃkaphaḥ varcaḥ upadhāvati iti etaiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ vidyāt apasmāram kapha ātmakam

original: 2.8.12 yas tv etat sarvamaśnāti yathoktaṃ doṣakopanam | sannipātādapasmāraṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ sa ṛcchati
analyzed: yaḥ tu etat sarvam aśnāti yathoktam doṣa kopanam sannipātāt apasmāram sarva liṅgam saḥ ṛcchati

original: 2.8.13 evaṃrasairihāpathyairvivṛddheṣv anilādiṣu | nā ' pasmārayateprāṇī na satvair upahanyate
analyzed: evaṃrasaiḥ iha apathyaiḥ vivṛddheṣu anila ādiṣu na apasmārayate prāṇī na sattvaiḥ upahanyate

original: 2.8.14 yadā yadābhivardhante doṣāḥparvasvivodadhiḥ | tadā tadāpasmarati naiṣa kliśyati santatam
analyzed: yadā yadā abhivardhante doṣāḥ parvasu iva udadhiḥ tadā tadā apasmarati na eṣa kliśyati santatam

original: 2.8.15 jvarasya śoṣagulmānāṃ kāsināmatha kuṣṭhinām | pramehonmādināṃ caiva tathāpasmāriṇām api
analyzed: jvarasya śoṣa gulmānām kāsinām atha kuṣṭhinām prameha unmādinām ca eva tathā apasmāriṇām api

original: 2.8.16 ity aṣṭau vai pradiṣṭāni nidānāni śarīriṇām | vimānāni pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthānaṃ samāptam || || vimānasthānam || | |prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto rasavimānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: iti aṣṭau vai pradiṣṭāni nidānāni śarīriṇām vimānāni pravakṣyāmi yathāvat anupūrvaśas iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele aṣṭamaḥ dhyāyaḥ iti bhela saṃhitāyām nidānasthānam samāptam vimānasthānam prathamaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas rasa vimānam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 3.1.1 śarīraṃ dhārayantīha ṣaḍrasāḥsamamāhṛtāḥ | ato ' nyathā vikārāṃs tu janayanti śarīriṇām
analyzed: śarīram dhārayanti iha ṣaṭ rasāḥ samam āhṛtāḥ atas nyathā vikārān tu janayanti śarīriṇām

original: 3.1.2 rūkṣo laghuḥsthiraśśītaḥ kaṣāyastikta eva ca | tīkṣṇoṣṇāvamlalavaṇaukaṭurvāpivikāśyatha
analyzed: rūkṣaḥ laghuḥ sthiraḥ śītaḥ kaṣāyaḥ tiktaḥ eva ca tīkṣṇa uṣṇau amla lavaṇau kaṭuḥ vā api vikāśī atha

original: 3.1.3 śītaḥ snigdho gururbalyaḥ picchilo madhuro rasaḥ | kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaḥ śīto rūkṣo ' nilaḥ smṛtaḥ
analyzed: śītaḥ snigdhaḥ guruḥ balyaḥ picchilaḥ madhuraḥ rasaḥ kaṣāya tikta kaṭukaḥ śītaḥ rūkṣaḥ nilaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: 3.1.4 rūkṣoṣṇamamlaṃ pittantu kaṭukaṃ ca pracakṣate | śleṣmā tu madhuraḥ snigdhaḥ śīto mandaḥ sthiro guruḥ
analyzed: rūkṣa uṣṇam amlam pittam tu kaṭukam ca pracakṣate śleṣmā tu madhuraḥ snigdhaḥ śītaḥ mandaḥ sthiraḥ guruḥ

original: 3.1.5 ity etān rasadoṣāṇāṃ sahotpannān guṇānviduḥ | tatra vāyuguṇaistulyān kaṣāyakaṭutiktakān
analyzed: iti etān rasa doṣāṇām saha utpannān guṇān viduḥ tatra vāyu guṇaiḥ tulyān kaṣāya kaṭu tiktakān

original: 3.1.6 kaṭvamlalavaṇaistulyāṃs tathā pittaguṇānviduḥ | madhuraṃ lavaṇāmlau ca vidyāt kaphasamān rasān
analyzed: kaṭu amla lavaṇaiḥ tulyān tathā pitta guṇān viduḥ madhuram lavaṇa amlau ca vidyāt kapha samān rasān

original: 4.4.29 kecidrakṣopahata ity āhuḥ, taccāyuktam | yadi hyevaṃ syād dṛśyeran puruṣaśarīre prahārādīni vā | tataśca[tastaccha] naivam | vetālābhibhūta[velāvabhūta] iti cetta cāpy anupapannam | puṇyāni hyeṣāṃmanāṃsi[vanāṃsi]dhyāyanti[dhyāyantye] | yadi caivaṃ kadācidbhavati | tasmāt tad eva pāṭhyaṃ rasopahatam iti cedevam eva | rasapravivekakāle tṛtīyakacaturthakāvapi[va] dṛśyete jvarāvapi |neṣatrāṃ hy ananārthaḥ?

original: 4.4.30 atrāha kiṃkhalvasya[jalpa] garbhasya prathamaṃ sambhavati?hastau[hastaṃ] pādāvitibaḍiśaḥ tatpratiṣṭhitatvāt [pratiṣṭatāt]śarīrasya[śaīraśva] | paścād guda iti śaunakaḥ tadāśritatvād vāyoḥ | nābhir iti khaṇḍakāpyaḥ tatra nāḍīnāṃpratiṣṭhitatvāt [pratiṣṭa] | hṛdayam iti parāśaraḥ vijñānamūlakānāṃ tanmūlatvāt | śira iti bharadvājaḥ śarīrasya tanmūlatvāt | cakṣuriti kāśyapaḥ | netyāha bhagavānpunarvasurātreyaḥ | tasmād arbudamevāsya prathamaṃ sambhavati | tatra sarve śarīrapradeśāssambhavanti arbudasnehotpannāḥ
analyzed: atra āha kim khalu asya jalpa garbhasya prathamam sambhavati hastau hastam pādau iti baḍiśaḥ tad pratiṣṭhita tvāt paścāt gudaḥ iti śaunakaḥ tad āśrita tvāt vāyoḥ nābhiḥ iti khaṇḍakāpyaḥ tatra nāḍīnām pratiṣṭhita tvāt pratiṣṭa hṛdayam iti parāśaraḥ vijñāna mūlakānām tad mūla tvāt śiraḥ iti bharadvājaḥ śarīrasya tad mūla tvāt cakṣuḥ iti kāśyapaḥ na iti āha bhagavān punarvasuḥ ātreyaḥ tasmāt arbudam eva āsyam iti asya anta

original: 4.4.31 atrāha---kiṃnu[tu]garbho[garvo] māturudarastho ' śnāti[māturastho] na veti | atrocyate nāśnāti | yadi hy aśnīyāt syādasya[asyā puruṣa] purīṣamatītakālaṃ, na cedamasti[cedasi] | kathaṃ tarhi? nābhyāṃ nāḍī pratiṣṭhitā tasyāmaparā māturhṛdayamāśritā tayā māturannaraso ' bhivahan garbhaṃ prīṇayatyabhivardhayati | tad yathā kulyāḥ kedāramabhisaṃśrayantyo bhāvayanti tadvat
analyzed: atra āha kim nu tu garbhaḥ garvaḥ mātuḥ udara sthaḥ śnāti mātura sthaḥ na vā iti atra ucyate na aśnāti yadi hi aśnīyāt syāt asya asyā puruṣa purīṣam atīta kālam na ced idam asti ced asi katham tarhi nābhyām nāḍī pratiṣṭhitā tasyām aparā mātuḥ hṛdayam āśritā tayā mātuḥ anna rasaḥ bhivahan garbham prīṇayati abhivardhayati tat yathā kulyāḥ kedāram abhisaṃśrayantyaḥ bhāvayanti tadvat

original: 4.4.32 tatrāha kathaṃ garbho māturudare tiṣṭhatīti | ūrdhvam iti śaunakaḥ | avākchirā iti bharadvājaḥ | nety āha bhagavānpunarvasurātreyaḥ | yady ūrdhvaṃ tiṣṭhet tarhi mātṛghātī syāt | yady avākchirāḥ svaghātī syāt | kathaṃ tarhi? tiryak sarvairayamaṅgapratyaṅgaiḥ pratibhugnaḥ śete ||tasya tadananataraṃ tatprathamaṃ pratipadyate [sandarbheṇānena pratipipādayiṣito ' rthaḥ na spaṣṭaḥ] | tasmāt tasya śiraḥ prathamaṃ punarvasurātreyaḥ pratipadyate | tadasya gurutaraṃ bhavatīti | atha khalu vṛkko medo gururiti saṃpravṛddhau parasparamabhivardhayanti
analyzed: tatra āha katham garbhaḥ mātuḥ udare tiṣṭhati iti ūrdhvam iti śaunakaḥ avāk śirāḥ iti bharadvājaḥ na iti āha bhagavān punarvasuḥ ātreyaḥ yadi ūrdhvam tiṣṭhet tarhi mātṛ ghātī syāt yadi avāk śirāḥ sva ghātī syāt katham tarhi tiryak sarvaiḥ ayam aṅga pratyaṅgaiḥ pratibhugnaḥ śete tasya tad ananataram tat prathamam pratipadyate sandarbheṇa anena pratipipādayiṣitaḥ rthaḥ na spaṣṭaḥ tasmāt tasya śiraḥ prathamam punarvasuḥ ātreyaḥ

original: 4.4.33 tatra ślokaḥ, ūṣmā rasastho dehe ' smiñjīvanaṃ gṛhya tiṣṭhati | rasodbhavaḥ pumāṃstasmād raso jīvanamucyate || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele śārīre caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ śarīranicayaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: tatra ślokaḥ ūṣmā rasa sthaḥ dehe smin jīvanam gṛhya tiṣṭhati rasa udbhavaḥ pumān tasmāt rasaḥ jīvanam ucyate iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele śārīre caturthaḥ dhyāyaḥ pañcamaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas śarīranicayam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 4.5.1 iha khalvojastejaḥ śarīre nity eca[va] bhavataḥ | tayoḥ[teyo] sthānāni dvādaśa bhavanti | tad yathā---tvakśoṇita[vaśoṇīta]-māṃsamedo ' sthimajjāśuklasvedapittaśleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇīti | tānyavyāpannāni sukham ity ucyate | vyāpannaistu[vyāpannestu] vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ praduṣṭā rasādiṣu vikārānupajanayanti
analyzed: iha khalu ojaḥ tejaḥ śarīre bhavataḥ bhavataḥ sthānāni dvādaśa bhavanti tat yathā sthānāni dvādaśa bhavanti tat yathā sthi majjā śukla sveda pitta śleṣma mūtra purīṣāṇi iti tāni avyāpannāni sukham iti ucyate vyāpannaiḥ tu vyāpanneḥ tu vāta pitta śleṣmāṇaḥ praduṣṭāḥ rasa ādiṣu vikārān upajanayanti

original: 4.5.2 atha yonayaścatasro bhavanti | tad yathā---jarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasvedajāśceti | tatra jarāyujājarāyuyuktāssaṃbhavanti[-yu] paśumṛgamanuṣyādayaḥ | śakuna-matsya[macha]-kacchapa-sarpa[sarva]-prabhṛtayoṇḍajāḥ | yūkāmat-kuṇa[kupa]-pataṅgāśiviṣamakṣikādayaḥ svedajāḥ | udbhijjās tu tṛṇalatāvṛkṣavanaspataya iti
analyzed: atha yonayaḥ catasraḥ bhavanti tat yathā jarāyu ja aṇḍaja udbhijja sveda jāḥ ca iti tatra paśu mṛga manuṣya ādayaḥ śakuna matsya macha kacchapa sarpa sarva prabhṛtayaḥ uṇḍajāḥ yūkā matkuṇa kupa pataṅga āśi viṣa makṣika ādayaḥ sveda jāḥ udbhijjāḥ tu tṛṇa latā vṛkṣa vanaspatayaḥ iti

original: 4.5.3 tatra puṣpaphalavanto vṛkṣāḥ | apuṣpaphalavanto vanaspatayaḥ | sapuṣpāḥ saphalāś cāpuṣpāś cāphalāś ca bīrudhaḥ | phalapākā latāścauṣadhayaḥ | tatra ye śvetakṣīrāḥ saumyāḥ, raktakṣīrāḥ kādrā vāruṇā vāligrahā? iti
analyzed: tatra puṣpa phalavantaḥ vṛkṣāḥ a puṣpa phalavantaḥ vanaspatayaḥ sa puṣpāḥ sa phalāḥ ca a puṣpāḥ ca a phalāḥ ca bīrudhaḥ phala pākāḥ latāḥ ca oṣadhayaḥ tatra ye śveta kṣīrāḥ saumyāḥ rakta kṣīrāḥ kādrāḥ vāruṇāḥ vāligrahāḥ iti

original: 4.5.4 iha khalu triṣu daśarātreṣu pumān rasena saṃyujyate | āsāṃ tu khalu catasṛṇāṃ yonīnāṃ ṛtukāle yadā rasāḥ samyak prāptiṃ vā gacchanti tadā garbhaḥtiṣṭhaty[tiṣṭe] avikṛtaḥ viparyaye viparyayaḥ
analyzed: iha khalu triṣu daśa rātreṣu pumān rasena saṃyujyate āsām tu khalu catasṛṇām yonīnām ṛtu kāle yadā rasāḥ samyak prāptim vā gacchanti tadā garbhaḥ tiṣṭhati tiṣṭe avikṛtaḥ viparyaye viparyayaḥ

original: 4.5.5tryahantu[-ha] khalu purāṇarudhiraṃ parivarjayet | kiñ ca tatpurāṇam? yadāditastryahaṃ parisravadṛtukāle tatpurāṇam | tasmin tryahe garbha-upakramaṇe[upakrameṇa] na tiṣṭhati | avasthito[avasthi vā] vā nāyuṣi samartho bhavati | nirgate[nirgave] tu tryaheṇa purāṇe rudhirecāvasthite[ṇa] śuddhasnātāyāścaturthaṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama[aṣṭa]-daśama-dvādaśeṣu[dvādaśamu] ahassu garbhovakramamāṇaḥ pumān bhavati | pañcamasaptama-navamaikādaśeṣu[-navaikādaśu] strītvāyopakalpate |sa eṣa āsaptarātrātsarvasañcāro ' bhidadhatyataḥ paramasañcārovakṛtatvād vālpāt?
analyzed: tri ahan tu ha khalu purāṇa rudhiram parivarjayet kim ca tat purāṇam yat āditas tri aham parisravat ṛtu kāle tat purāṇam tasmin tri ahe garbha aupakramaṇe upakrameṇa na tiṣṭhati avasthitaḥ avasthi vā vā na āyuṣi samarthaḥ bhavati nirgate nirgave tu tri aheṇa purāṇe rudhire ca avasthiteṇa śuddha snātāyāḥ caturtha ṣaṣṭha aṣṭama aṣṭadaśama dvādaśeṣu dvādaśamu ahaḥsu garbhaḥ uvakramamāṇaḥ pumān bhavati pañcama saptama navama ekādaśeṣ

original: 4.5.6 strīṇāṃ khalu śoṇitaṃ śarīraṃ śoṣayati tasmānna tāḥ rajaḥ paśyanti | paripūrṇadhātuśarīrās tu yadā bhavanti tadā vivekajalalohitaṃ māse māse prativedayanti | pratigatapraveśaṃ ca tatpunarmāsena samāgacchatyārtavam
analyzed: strīṇām khalu śoṇitam śarīram śoṣayati tasmāt na tāḥ rajaḥ paśyanti paripūrṇa dhātu śarīrāḥ tu yadā bhavanti tadā viveka jala lohitam māse māse prativedayanti pratigata praveśam ca tat punar māsena samāgacchati ārtavam

original: 4.5.7 yadā tu tacchoṇitaṃ duṣṭaṃ mārgaṃ pratipadyate tadā strīṇāṃ pradaro bhavati | taṃ śarīraṃśoṣayantaṃ[śoṣaya] lohitapittabheṣajenopakrameta
analyzed: yadā tu tat śoṇitam duṣṭam mārgam pratipadyate tadā strīṇām pradaraḥ bhavati tam śarīram śoṣayantam śoṣaya lohita pitta bheṣajena upakrameta

original: 4.5.8 garbhiṇyās tu tridhā kāye raso ' bhinirvartate, garbhatvāya[garbhātpā] stanyatvāya rasatvāya ceti
analyzed: garbhiṇyāḥ tu tridhā kāye rasaḥ bhinirvartate garbha tvāya garbhātpāḥ stanya tvāya rasa tvāya ca iti

original: 4.5.9 iha khalu bhoḥ garbhātsthirādantaḥsthādāyatamudaraṃ[-sthitāvasthātamā] bhavati madhye nāryāmantargatāyām | sthūlamūlasaṃsthitasaṃvṛttamacchidraṃ puruṣo ' ntargate | droṇīvodaraṃ[droṇicodaraṃ] bhavatyubhayor antargatayoḥ | vāmaṃ pārśvamāyataṃ māturudarasthā strī, dakṣiṇe pumān, madhye napuṃsakam | vāmamakṣi hrasati nāryāmantargatāyām, puruṣe dakṣiṇam, ubhe napuṃsake | savyaṃ pādaṃ pūrvaṃ prakrāmati savyena cākṣṇā bhruvā ca pūrvaṃ prati kurute, ceṣṭateca[na]savyena[sarvena] pārśvena prāyaḥ saṃviśati[śaṃsate] strīsaṃjñāneṣu ca prāyaśo dauhṛdaṃ kurute nāryāmantargatāyām | viparyaye tadataḥ puruṣaṃ bibhartīti vidyāt
analyzed: iha khalu bhoḥ garbhāt sthirāt antaḥsthāt āyatam udaraṃsthitāvasthātamā bhavati madhye nāryām antargatāyām sthūla mūla saṃsthita saṃvṛttam acchidram puruṣaḥ ntargate droṇī iva udaram droṇica udaram bhavati ubhayoḥ antargatayoḥ vāmam pārśvam āyatam mātuḥ udara sthā strī dakṣiṇe pumān madhye napuṃsakam vāmam akṣi hrasati nāryām antargatāyām puruṣe dakṣiṇam ubhe napuṃsake savyam pādam pūrvam prakrāmati savyena ca akṣṇā bhruvā ca pūr

original: 4.5.10 athaiha[ye] khalu garbhasya ṣaḍbhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīramabhinirvartate | tad yathā---jalakāyād vāyukāyāt tejaḥkāyāt pṛthivīkāyād ākāśakāyād rasakāyāc ceti
analyzed: atha aihaye khalu garbhasya ṣaḍbhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīram abhinirvartate tat yathā jala kāyāt vāyu kāyāt tejaḥ kāyāt pṛthivī kāyāt ākāśa kāyāt rasa kāyāt ca iti

original: 4.5.11 ṣaḍdhātur evāyaṃ puruṣo bhavati | dhātavaḥ punaḥ pañca bhūtāni brahmayadavyaktam[padavyaktam]
analyzed: ṣaṣ dhātuḥ eva ayam puruṣaḥ bhavati dhātavaḥ punar pañca bhūtāni brahma yat avyaktam padavyaktam

original: 4.5.12 tatra yat kharakaṭhinam, tad yathā---dantakeśaroma-nakha[mukha]-purīṣasnāyvasthi, gandhajñānaghrāṇasaṅghātagauravāṇīti | yad dravaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛdu vā tadaudakam
analyzed: tatra yat khara kaṭhinam tat yathā danta keśa roma nakha mukha purīṣa snāyu asthi gandha jñāna ghrāṇa saṅghāta gauravāṇi iti yat dravam snigdham mṛdu vā tat audakam

original: 4.5.13tadyadā[tadyamu] sannipatitayor yatra puruṣaḥ pūrvamarthaṃ[sarvamardha] nandayati jaghanyaṃ strī tatra pumānihāṅgapratyaṅgaiḥ[pumānipratyaṅgaiḥ] sadṛśo jāyate | yatra tu strī prathamamarthaṃ sādhayati jaghanyaṃ puruṣaḥ, tatra strī vāṅgapratyaṅgaissadṛśī[sadṛśo] jāyate
analyzed: sannipatitayoḥ yatra puruṣaḥ pūrvam artham sarvam ardha nandayati jaghanyam strī tatra pumān iha aṅga pratyaṅgaiḥ pumān i pratyaṅgaiḥ sadṛśaḥ jāyate yatra tu strī prathamam artham sādhayati jaghanyam puruṣaḥ tatra strī vā aṅga pratyaṅgaiḥ sadṛśī sadṛśaḥ jāyate

original: 4.5.14 athastrīpuruṣāvṛtukāle[-nāle] rūkṣāṇi vātalānyannāni[vātaśānyannāni] sevete, vegāṃś ca dhārayataḥ, tayor garbhaḥ śoṇitādiṣu vātasaṃdūṣiteṣuniḥsṛto[viḥsṛto] bhavati, gadgadabādhiryaminmiṇatvamanyeṣāṃ ca vātapittavikārāṇāmanyatamaṃ prāpnoti | evam eva pittaśleṣmalānṛtukāle mātāpitroḥ sevamānayoḥ pittaśleṣmavidūṣito garbhaḥ sambhavati
analyzed: atha strī puruṣau ṛtu kālena āle rūkṣāṇi vātalāni annāni vātaśāni annāni sevete vegān ca dhārayataḥ tayoḥ garbhaḥ śoṇita ādiṣu vāta saṃdūṣiteṣu niḥsṛtaḥ viḥsṛtaḥ bhavati gadgada bādhiryam inmiṇa tvam anyeṣām ca vāta pitta vikārāṇām anyatamam prāpnoti evam eva pitta śleṣmalān ṛtu kāle mātā pitroḥ sevamānayoḥ pitta śleṣma vidūṣitaḥ garbhaḥ sambhavati

original: 4.5.15 atha khalu garbhaśarīraṃ catrudaśendriyakāyāḥ samanupraviśanti | vidhṛtāś cānupalabhyamānāś ca saptadivyāḥ saptamānuṣāḥ
analyzed: atha khalu garbha śarīram catru daśa indriya kāyāḥ samanupraviśanti vidhṛtāḥ ca an upalabhyamānāḥ ca sapta divyāḥ sapta mānuṣāḥ

original: 5.10.11 yasya pakvāvubhāvoṣṭhau nīlaujambūphalopamau | ucchūnaṃ yasya ca śiraḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam

original: 5.10.12 yasyocchūnaṃ bhavenmadhyamubhāvaṃsau kṛśau tathā | viriktaḥ punarādhmāti yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ
analyzed: yasya ucchūnam bhavet madhyam ubhau aṃsau kṛśau tathā viriktaḥ yathā pretaḥ tathā eva saḥ

original: 5.10.13 etadindriyavijñānaṃ yassamyaganupaśyati | sajīvitaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vidyādbhiṣagvaraḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele indriye daśamo ' dhyāyaḥ || || ekadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ puṣpīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: etat indriya vijñānam yaḥ samyak anupaśyati sa jīvitam ca mṛtyum ca nṛṇām vidyāt bhiṣaj varaḥ iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele indriye daśamaḥ dhyāyaḥ ekadaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas puṣpīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 5.11.1 śirasyaṅge raktavarṇaṃ yo ' nilaṃ vāpi paśyati | ghaṭikāmekavarṇaṃ vā sa puṣpita ihocyate
analyzed: śirasi aṅge rakta varṇam yaḥ nilam vā api paśyati ghaṭikām eka varṇam vā sa puṣpitaḥ iha ucyate

original: 5.11.2 aṣṭāpadaṃ vā sukṛtaṃ jagatīṃ yaḥ prapaśyati | sa dṛṣṭiparihīnatvāt puṣpitaḥ procyate naraḥ
analyzed: aṣṭāpadam vā su kṛtam jagatīm yaḥ prapaśyati sa dṛṣṭi parihīna tvāt puṣpitaḥ procyate naraḥ

original: 5.11.3 suptaś ca saṃvṛte gehe paśyatyākāśam eva yaḥ | romanthayati dantaiś ca sa puṣpita ihocyate
analyzed: suptaḥ ca saṃvṛte gehe paśyati ākāśam eva yaḥ dantaiḥ ca sa puṣpitaḥ iha ucyate

original: 5.11.4 dīpyamānamivākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca vanāni ca | yo vettiromasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ puṣpitaḥ sa ihocyate
analyzed: dīpyamānam iva ākāśam pṛthivīm ca vanāni ca yaḥ vetti roma saṃhṛṣṭaḥ puṣpitaḥ saḥ iha ucyate

original: 5.11.5 anullipto yathā dehī vāticetkuṇapaṃ yathā | sevante makṣikāś caiva puṣpitaḥ sa ihocyate
analyzed: an ulliptaḥ yathā dehī vā ati ced kuṇapam yathā sevante makṣikāḥ ca eva puṣpitaḥ saḥ iha ucyate

original: 5.11.6 avijñātā naraṃ nārī svapnaeva nivāsinī | dakṣiṇāṃ diśamehīti yaṃ brūyānna sa jīvati
analyzed: a vijñātā naram nārī svapna eva nivāsinī dakṣiṇām diśam ehi iti yam brūyāt na sa jīvati

original: 5.11.7 prakīrṇakeśo vikaraḥ svapne yo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam | pratipadyeta tatraiva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
analyzed: prakīrṇa keśaḥ vikaraḥ svapne yaḥ dakṣiṇām diśam pratipadyeta tatra eva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.11.8 kuśair iva nirūḍhāṅgamātmānaṃ svapna īkṣate | khaṃ vā sadhūmaṃ yo vetti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
analyzed: kuśaiḥ iva nirūḍha aṅgam ātmānam svapne īkṣate kham vā sa dhūmam yaḥ vetti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.11.9 yaḥ svapne vṛkṣamāruhya na rogī trāyate gṛhe | prakīrṇakeśo vikacaḥyo ' gnimāruhya roditi
analyzed: yaḥ svapne vṛkṣam āruhya na rogī trāyate gṛhe prakīrṇa keśaḥ vikacaḥ yaḥ gnim āruhya roditi

original: 5.11.10 prāsādamekasthūṇaṃ tu svapne yaś cādhirohati | naro nṛtyati paṅke vāsa pumānna ca jīvati
analyzed: prāsādam eka sthūṇam tu svapne yaḥ ca adhirohati naraḥ nṛtyati paṅke pumān na ca jīvati

original: 5.11.11 svapne prāsādamāruhya mahāntaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā | yonṛttagītapānānnī na sa jīvati mānavaḥ
analyzed: svapne prāsādam āruhya mahāntam kāñcanam tathā yaḥ nṛtta gīta pāna annī na sa jīvati mānavaḥ

original: 5.11.12 gajenoṣṭreṇa vā gacchan yaḥ paśyeddakṣiṇāṃ diśam | jīvet tu rogī saptāhaṃ, nīrogaḥ śaradāṃ śatam
analyzed: gajena uṣṭreṇa vā gacchan yaḥ paśyet dakṣiṇām diśam jīvet tu rogī sapta aham nīrogaḥ śaradām śatam

original: 5.11.13 yāti yo durdine vāpi svapne vā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam | pratibudhyeta tatraiva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
analyzed: yāti yaḥ durdine vā api svapne vā dakṣiṇām diśam pratibudhyeta tatra eva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.11.14 bhāsairbarhivarāhaiś ca śvabhir mahiṣavājibhiḥ | samaṃ yo taddivā yone svapne yogaphalaṃ bhavet
analyzed: bhāsaiḥ barhi varāhaiḥ ca śvabhiḥ mahiṣa vājibhiḥ samam tat divā yone svapne yoga phalam bhavet

original: 5.11.15 yadā gaṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca svapne cāśnaṃś ca paśyati | prakīrṇakeśam api ca na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
analyzed: yadā gaṇḍam ca khaḍgam ca svapne ca aśnan ca paśyati prakīrṇa keśam api ca na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.11.16 yaḥ svapne puruṣaḥ kālaṃ pītaṃ vā vastramṛcchati | gāyannaceṣṭayanvāpi na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
analyzed: yaḥ svapne puruṣaḥ kālam pītam vā vastram ṛcchati gāyan a ceṣṭayan vā api na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.11.17 yaḥ svapnevītakāmo ' pi pītāṃ pibati vāruṇīm | citrakaṇṭhaguṇo vāpi na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
analyzed: yaḥ pītām pibati vāruṇīm citrakaṇṭha guṇaḥ vā api na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.11.18ākulāpāṃ nadīṃ svapne yovagāheta mānavaḥ | jīvetsarogassaptāhaṃ, nīrogasśaradāṃ śatam
analyzed: nadīm svapne yaḥ uvagāheta mānavaḥ jīvet sa rogaḥ sapta aham nīrogaḥ śaradām śatam

original: 5.11.19 svapne snātānuliptasya bhraṃśedyasya tuvarṇakaḥ | gātrasya puruṣasyehasa śastreṇa vinaśyati
analyzed: svapne snāta anuliptasya bhraṃśet yasya śastreṇa vinaśyati

original: 5.11.20 etadindriyavijñānaṃ yassamyaganupaśyati | jīvitaṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele indriye ekādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || || dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātoavākcitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: etat indriya vijñānam yaḥ samyak anupaśyati jīvitam ca eva mṛtyum ca nṛṇām vidyāt vicakṣaṇaḥ iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele indriye ekādaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ dvādaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas avākcitīyam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 5.12.1 avākcitā vā jihmā vā yasya chāyālpikā bhāvet | netre ca viṣame syātāṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam || 5.1
analyzed: avāk citā vā jihmā vā yasya chāyā alpikā bhāvet netre ca viṣame syātām paretam tasya jīvitam

original: 5.12.2 yadi dīnāni pakṣmāṇi na nimīlanti dehinaḥ | dahyete nayane vāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam
analyzed: yadi dīnāni pakṣmāṇi na nimīlanti dehinaḥ dahyete nayane vā api paretam tasya jīvitam

original: 5.12.3namantyau yasya dṛśyetebhruvau mūrdhani bā sthite | jīvet tu satryahaṃ rogī ṣaṇmāsān vyādhivarjitaḥ
analyzed: namantyau yasya dṛśyete bhruvau mūrdhani bā sthite jīvet tu sa tri aham rogī ṣaṣ māsān vyādhi varjitaḥ

original: 5.12.4luñcyamāneṣu keśeṣuvedayannāti vedanām | nivṛttasukhaduḥkhaḥ syāt paretaṃ tasya jīvitam
analyzed: luñcyamāneṣu keśeṣuvedayan na ati vedanām nivṛtta sukha duḥkhaḥ syāt paretam tasya jīvitam

original: 5.12.5 yasyāturasya piṭakā vyaṅgo vā dṛśyate mukhe | adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ prathamaṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam

analyzed: śuṣyate nāsikā vaṃśaḥ pṛthu tvam yasya gacchati aṃsaḥ nilāt kāsavataḥ paretam tasya jīvitam

original: 5.12.7 atyuṣṇaṃ vātiśītaṃ vā stabdhaṃ vā mṛdu vāpy atha | manyate pāṇipādaṃ ca paretaṃ tasya jībitam

analyzed: yaḥ vatīrya nadīm pūrṇām toye paśyati jālakam gātram liptam atha adbhiḥ ca yasya na asti iti tam viduḥ

original: 5.12.9 vivartayati yaḥ śīrṣamatyarthaṃ canasā naraḥ | na svidyate lalāṭaṃ ca nāsti tasya cikitsitam
analyzed: vivartayati yaḥ śīrṣam atyartham canasā naraḥ na svidyate lalāṭam ca nā asti tasya cikitsitam

original: 5.12.11 yasyodaraṃsamādhmātaṃ tadvartma ca vibhāvyate | bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ
analyzed: yasya udaram samādhmātam tat vartma ca vibhāvyate bhinnam purīṣam tṛṣṇā ca yathā pretaḥ tathā eva saḥ

original: 5.12.12anārataṃ gṛhe yasyakāṃsyaṃ bhidyeta dehinaḥ | candrastīkṣṇo mṛduścārko yasya syāt taṃ vivarjayet
analyzed: anāratam gṛhe dehinaḥ candraḥ tīkṣṇaḥ mṛduḥ ca arkaḥ yasya syāt tam vivarjayet

analyzed: apradhātuḥ pradhātuḥ vā svasthaḥ vā yat iva āturaḥ yaḥ candanam iva āvāti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ

original: 5.12.14 yūthikotpannagaṇḍaśca, vāti yaś cāpi vartmavat | abhaktaḥ tasimaṃ bālye yo vāti na sa jīvati
analyzed: yūthika utpanna gaṇḍaḥ ca vāti yaḥ ca api vartma vat abhaktaḥ tasimam bālye yaḥ vāti na sa jīvati

analyzed: dviṣadbhiḥ kurute sakhyam yaḥ priyaiḥ yāt vipriyam akasmāt kupyate yaḥ tu paretam tasya jīvitam

original: 5.12.16ebhir evaṃvidhairliṅgairanyaiś cāpi yathāyatham | nopakrameta medhāvī bhiṣaganvitamāturam
analyzed: ebhiḥ evaṃvidhaiḥ liṅgaiḥ anyaiḥ ca api yathāyatham na upakrameta medhāvī bhiṣaj anvitam āturam

original: 5.12.17 etadbhiṣagariṣṭānāṃ yo jñānamanubudhyate | yathoktaṃ veda vedāyuḥ sa bhiṣak śāstrakovidaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele indriye dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyām indriyasthānaṃ samāptam || | |cikitsāsthānam || || prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta ekādaśasarpiṣkaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ
analyzed: etat bhiṣaj ariṣṭānām yaḥ jñānam anubudhyate yathoktam veda veda āyuḥ sa bhiṣak śāstra kovidaḥ iti āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele indriye dvādaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ iti bhela saṃhitāyām indriya sthānam samāptam cikitsā sthānam prathamaḥ dhyāyaḥ atha atas ekādaśasarpiṣkam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha sma āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ

original: 6.1.1 akalpayan na yajñāṅgaṃ purā dakṣastriśūline | tasmāt praṇāśayāmāsa yajñaṃ dakṣasya śaṅkaraḥ
analyzed: akalpayat na yajña aṅgam purā dakṣaḥ triśūline tasmāt praṇāśayāmāsa yajñam dakṣasya śaṅkaraḥ

original: 6.1.2 taṃ ca nāśayatā yajñaṃ devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā | krodhenoṣṇaṃ viniśvasya tān lokān vyāpito jvaraḥ
analyzed: tam ca nāśayatā yajñam devyāḥ priya cikīrṣayā krodhena uṣṇam viniśvasya tān lokān vyāpitaḥ jvaraḥ

original: 6.1.3 sa eṣa santāpayati jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | nidhane cāpi bhūtānāṃ nānyo heturvinā jvarāt
analyzed: saḥ eṣa santāpayati jagat sthāvara jaṅgamam nidhane ca api bhūtānām na anyaḥ hetuḥ vinā jvarāt

original: 6.1.4 yāvanto ' nye samākhyātā vyādhayas tu śarīriṇām | saṃvatsareṇa te ghnanti sadyaḥ prāṇaharo jvaraḥ
analyzed: yāvantaḥ nye samākhyātāḥ vyādhayaḥ tu śarīriṇām saṃvatsareṇa te ghnanti sadyas prāṇa haraḥ jvaraḥ

original: 6.1.5 rogānīkasya sarvasya jvaro rājā prakīrtitaḥ | jvarayatyeṣa bhūtāni tasmājjvara iti smṛtiḥ
analyzed: roga anīkasya sarvasya jvaraḥ rājā prakīrtitaḥ jvarayati eṣa bhūtāni tasmāt jvaraḥ iti smṛtiḥ

original: 6.1.6 śārīramānasānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃpravaro jvaraḥ | tasmāt prathamatas tasya pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam
analyzed: śārīra mānasānām ca rogāṇām pravaraḥ jvaraḥ tasmāt prathamatas tasya pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam

original: 6.1.7 uktarūpasamutthānā jvarāś cāṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ | śītaścoṣṇaś ca niyataḥ samāsātdvividho jvaraḥ
