original: 6.1.8 śītasyoṣṇāṃ kriyāṃ kuryād vātaśleṣmātmakasya tu | uṣṇasyaikāntapittasya śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ bhiṣak
analyzed: śītasya uṣṇām kriyām kuryāt vāta śleṣma ātmakasya tu uṣṇasya ekānta pittasya śītām kuryāt kriyām bhiṣak

original: 6.1.9 vāyur āmāśayāt pūrvamūṣmāṇaṃ samudīrayet | tvaggato roma cāpannaḥ saṃharṣayati mānavam
analyzed: vāyuḥ āmāśayāt pūrvam ūṣmāṇam samudīrayet tvac gataḥ roma ca āpannaḥ saṃharṣayati mānavam

original: 6.1.10 sa tu pittānubandhena tejasā paripācitaḥ | prāpnoti vilayaṃ śleṣmā sambandheneva toyadaḥ
analyzed: sa tu pitta anubandhena tejasā paripācitaḥ prāpnoti vilayam śleṣmā sambandhena iva toya daḥ

original: 6.1.11śānte śīte punardāhaṃ pittātprāpnoti mānavaḥ | utpittamindhanībhūtaṃvapurdahati pāvakaḥ
analyzed: śānte śīte punar dāham pittāt prāpnoti mānavaḥ utpittam indhanībhūtam vapuḥ dahati pāvakaḥ

original: 6.1.12gatavegenilaḥpaścādūṣmaṇā paripācitaḥ | svam evabhajate sthānamānulomyaṃ ca gacchati
analyzed: gata vega inilaḥ paścāt ūṣmaṇā paripācitaḥ svam eva bhajate sthānam ānulomyam ca gacchati

original: 6.1.13 evaṃ jvaramavāpnotihyevam eva ca mucyate | etad buddhimatāṃ proktaṃ samāsena cikitsitam
analyzed: evam jvaram avāpnoti hi evam eva ca mucyate etat buddhimatām proktam samāsena cikitsitam

original: 6.1.14 durlabhā buddhimantas tu tasmād vakṣyāmi vistaram | ekādaśaprakāraṃ hijvaritānāṃ cikitsitam
analyzed: durlabhāḥ buddhimantaḥ tu tasmāt vakṣyāmi vistaram ekādaśa prakāram hi jvaritānām cikitsitam

original: 6.1.15 sarpiś caikādaśaṃ vidyāt tan me vistarataḥ śṛṇu | siddhās svedāḥ kaṣāyāś ca lehaḥ pācanakāni ca
analyzed: sarpiḥ ca ekādaśam vidyāt tat me vistarataḥ śṛṇu siddhāḥ svedāḥ kaṣāyāḥ ca lehaḥ pācanakāni ca

original: 6.1.16 cūrṇaḥ pradehāssekāś ca vaṭikā modakāḥ payaḥ | sarpiś caikādaśaṃ proktaṃ siddhamāmamathāpi ca
analyzed: cūrṇaḥ ca vaṭikāḥ modakāḥ payaḥ sarpiḥ ca ekādaśam proktam siddham āmam atha api ca

original: 6.1.17 eṣāṃ prayogaṃ vakṣyāmi vīryāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak | śleṣmāṇamanilaṃ caiva jitvā pittantu dehinām
analyzed: eṣām prayogam vakṣyāmi vīryāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak śleṣmāṇam anilam ca eva jitvā pittam tu dehinām

original: 6.1.18 karoti yasmādūṣmāṇaṃ tasmājjvarita ucyate | vāyuḥ pittena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śleṣmā vā pittamūrcchitaḥ
analyzed: karoti yasmāt ūṣmāṇam tasmāt jvaritaḥ ucyate vāyuḥ pittena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śleṣmā vā pitta mūrcchitaḥ

original: 6.1.19 ūṣmāṇaṃ kurute yasmāttataḥ pittamupācaret | tṛṣyate coṣṇasalilaṃ deyaṃ doṣavipācanam
analyzed: ūṣmāṇam kurute yasmāt tatas pittam upācaret tṛṣyate ca uṣṇa salilam deyam doṣa vipācanam

original: 6.1.20 jvaraghnaṃ dīpanīyaṃ ca kaphapittānilāpaham | srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ caiva rucisvedakaraṃ nṛṇām

original: 6.4.51 akṣapramāṇasaṃsthānāḥ kāryās tu modakās tathā | yavagodhūmacūrṇābhyāṃ tugākṣīryā ca cūrṇitān
analyzed: akṣa pramāṇa saṃsthānāḥ kāryāḥ tu modakāḥ tathā yava godhūma cūrṇābhyām tugākṣīryā ca cūrṇitān

original: 6.4.52 bhakṣayenmodakān kāle kṣīrapānaṃ pibetpunaḥ | yakṣmāṇaṃ śamayantyete vṛkṣamindrāśaniryathā

original: 6.4.53asṛgdaraṃ kṣataṃ kṣīṇaṃ hṛdrogaṃ viṣamajvaram | unmāda raktapittaṃ ca kāsaṃ caitena sādhayet

original: 6.4.54 aśvatthasyātha mūlāni śuṅgāni saphalāni ca | śatāvarīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām

original: 6.4.55 golomīṃ śreyasīṃ kālāṃ śāribāṃ sapunarnavām | kṣīradroṇeṣu daśasu kuṭṭitāni vipācayet
analyzed: golomīm śreyasīm kālām śāribām sa punarnavām kṣīra droṇeṣu daśasu kuṭṭitāni vipācayet

original: 6.4.56tacchṛtaṃ śītalaṃ pūtaṃkhajenābhipramanthayet | yattatra sarpirjāyetataduddhṛtya vipācayet
analyzed: tat śṛtam śītalam pūtam khajena abhipramanthayet yat tatra sarpiḥ jāyeta tat uddhṛtya vipācayet

original: 6.4.57 bhaiṣajyāni ca piṣṭāni tatremāni samācaret | madhukaṃ madhuliṃ drākṣāṃ medāṃ vṛṣabhajīrakau
analyzed: bhaiṣajyāni ca piṣṭāni tatra imāni samācaret madhukam madhulim drākṣām medām vṛṣabha jīrakau

original: 6.4.58 tālamajjāṃsalāmajjaṃ tathāpuṣkarabījakam | jīvanīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca madhukāni kaśerukam
analyzed: tālamajja aṃsalāmajjam tathā puṣkarabījakam jīvanīm trāyamāṇām ca madhukāni kaśerukam

original: 6.4.59 nīlotpalaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ vārtākānapi coccaṭām | kāśmaryāmalakekṣūṇāṃ vidāryāḥ svarasaṃ ca vā
analyzed: nīlotpalam puṇḍarīkam vārtākān api ca uccaṭām kāśmarī āmalaka ikṣūṇām vidāryāḥ svarasam ca vā

original: 6.4.60 tatsiddhaṃ dāpayet pūtaṃ kalaśe rājate dṛḍhe | tulārdhaṃ śarkarāyāś ca dattvā caivābhimanthayet
analyzed: tat siddham dāpayet pūtam kalaśe rājate dṛḍhe tulā ardham śarkarāyāḥ ca dattvā ca eva abhimanthayet

original: 6.4.61 prakṣipec ca tugākṣīryāḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ ca mākṣikāt | ātmaguptāphalasya syād guḍasya maricasya ca
analyzed: prakṣipet ca tugākṣīryāḥ prastham prastham ca mākṣikāt ātmaguptā phalasya syāt guḍasya maricasya ca

original: 6.4.62 uccaṭīkṣurasābhyāṃ ca dvau prasthau tatra dāpayet | tvagelānāgapuṣpāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tatra pradāpayet
analyzed: uccaṭī ikṣu rasābhyām ca dvau prasthau tatra dāpayet tvac elā nāgapuṣpāṇām cūrṇam tatra pradāpayet

original: 6.4.63 palikān modakān kṛtvā sthāpayenmṛṇmaye nave | aśnīyāttatpalaṃkalyaṃ sāyaṃ bhūyaḥpalaṃ naraḥ
analyzed: palikān modakān kṛtvā sthāpayet mṛṇmaye nave aśnīyāt tad palam kalyam sāyam bhūyaḥpalam naraḥ

original: 6.4.64 śayanaṃ mṛdu seveta brahmacārī samāhitaḥ | karmaṇānena niyataṃ yakṣmāṇamapakarṣati

original: 6.4.65 saṃbṛhayatiśuṣkaṃ ca puruṣaṃdurbalendriyam | vājīkaraṇamapyetannarāṇāṃ kṣīṇaretasām
analyzed: saṃbṛhayati śuṣkam ca puruṣam durbala indriyam vājīkaraṇam api etat narāṇām kṣīṇa retasām

original: 6.4.66 strībhir hatā bhārahatāḥ jīrṇāś cātītayauvanāḥ | kṣīṇamāṃsāḥ kṣīṇabalāḥ ye cātha kṣīṇaśoṇitāḥ
analyzed: strībhiḥ hatāḥ bhāra hatāḥ jīrṇāḥ ca atīta yauvanāḥ kṣīṇa māṃsāḥ kṣīṇa balāḥ ye ca atha kṣīṇa śoṇitāḥ

original: 6.4.67 pittaroge raktapitte śoṣe doṣajvare tathā | hatendriyā naṣṭaśuklāḥsaktakaṇṭhāś ca ye smṛtāḥ
analyzed: pitta roge raktapitte śoṣe doṣa jvare tathā hata indriyāḥ naṣṭa śuklāḥ sakta kaṇṭhāḥ ca ye smṛtāḥ

original: 6.4.68 aśaktamandakā ye caratinaṣṭendriyā narāḥ | punarnavāṃstānkurute yogo ' yamamṛtopamaḥ
analyzed: aśakta mandakāḥ ye carati naṣṭa indriyāḥ narāḥ punarnavān tān kurute yogaḥ yam amṛta upamaḥ

original: 6.4.69 apasmārānathonmādān hṛdrogānapatantrakam | tejo vāpahṛtaṃyeṣāṃ bhūtadharmeṇa kenacit
analyzed: apasmārān atha unmādān hṛd rogān apatantrakam tejaḥ vā apahṛtam yeṣām bhūta dharmeṇa kenacid

original: 6.4.70 kṣīrānupānāttanvanti sadyaḥpoṣaṃ hi modakāḥ | vyākulātyalpādhātūnāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ mandadehinām
analyzed: kṣīra anupānāt tanvanti sadyas poṣam hi modakāḥ vyākula ati alpa adhātūnām śoṣiṇām manda dehinām

original: 6.4.71 api yogaśatenāpi duḥkham eva cikitsitam | tasmād rasāyanavidhiṃ vardhamāne kṣaye bhiṣak
analyzed: api yoga śatena api duḥkham eva cikitsitam tasmāt rasāyana vidhim vardhamāne kṣaye bhiṣak

original: 6.4.72 saṃvatsaraṃparamṛtumayanaṃ vā samācaret | pippalīvardhamānaṃ tu pañcapañcavivardhitam
analyzed: saṃvatsaram param ṛtum ayanam vā samācaret pippalī vardhamānam tu pañca pañca vivardhitam

original: 6.4.73nasye cābhyañjane pāne praśastaṃ bastikarmaṇi | vātavyādhiṣu sarveṣu kṣatakṣīṇe śirograhe
analyzed: nasye ca abhyañjane pāne praśastam vasti karmaṇi vāta vyādhiṣu sarveṣu kṣata kṣīṇe śiraḥ grahe

original: 6.4.82 pānābhyañjananasyeṣu bastau vyañjanasādhane | bhojane cāmṛtaprakhyaṃ narāṇāṃ rājayakṣmiṇām

analyzed: hṛd rogam tāluśoṣam ca pārśvaśūlam pratānakam tṛṣṇām unmāda vīsarpam kāsam śvāsam asṛgdaram

analyzed: raktapittam pravṛddham ca sarvatas bhāga mūrcchitam kāmalām pāṇḍu rogam ca pānāt etat niyacchati

analyzed: bahu uparodhāḥ teṣām vṛṣyatamam matam prayogeṇa prayuktam ca rasāyanam anuttamam

analyzed: aśvagandhā hi apāmārgaḥ nākulī gaurasarṣapāḥ tilāḥ bilvam ca kalkam syāt tatra rakṣaya unmardanam param

original: 6.4.92 maṅgalācārasaṃyukto bhavetsvastyayano naraḥ | snānāni śāntihomāṃś ca śoṣī nityaṃ samācarete

original: 6.5.1 pañca gulmāḥ samuddiṣṭā nidāneṣu savistaram | gulmatvaṃ teṣu vakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ tu pṛthak pṛthak

original: 6.5.2 mārutaḥ kupito dehe srotāṃsyunnahya sarvaśaḥ | abhyāgatya dūṣayati pūrvaṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ tataḥ

original: 6.5.8 madhūcchiṣṭamayaṃ piṇḍaṃ cinvanti bhramarā yathā | tathā koṣṭheṣu pavano dhātūṃstānvicinoty api
analyzed: madhūcchiṣṭa mayam piṇḍam cinvanti bhramarāḥ yathā tathā koṣṭheṣu pavanaḥ dhātūn tān vicinoti api

original: 6.5.9 sthānāni tasya gulmasya śaṃmanti gurulāghavam | kukṣikastigato gulmo vātabhūyiṣṭha ucyate

original: 6.5.11 evaṃ śleṣmaṇi rakte ca sannipāte ca sarvaśaḥ | sarveṣāṃ sannipāte tu svaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ nidarśanam
analyzed: evam śleṣmaṇi rakte ca sannipāte ca sarvaśas sarveṣām sannipāte tu svam svam rūpam nidarśanam

original: 6.5.12 āganturdūṣayatyatradhātuṃ sthānasthaulbaṇaḥ | cikitsitaṃ tusthānasya sa hi tatra balādhikaḥ
analyzed: āgantuḥ dūṣayati atra dhātum sthāna sthaulbaṇaḥ cikitsitam sa hi tatra bala adhikaḥ

analyzed: doṣa dvayena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sarve gulmāḥ pramāthinaḥ tasmāt teṣām bhedanīyāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ prayojayet atyartham snihyamānaḥ api gulmaḥ vṛddhim avāpnuyāt

original: 6.5.17harītakī trikaṭukaṃvacā kaṭukarohiṇī | sauvarcalaṃ yavakṣāro viḍaṅgaṃcitrakas tathā
